Swiss Investor Confidence Deteriorates in June — Swiss investor sentiment deteriorated to -25.0 in June 2026 from -11.1 in May, remaining firmly in negative territory, according to the UBS & CFA Society Switzerland survey. The expectations index declined by 13.9 points on the month, partially reversing the improvement recorded over the previous two months as confidence weakened following the recovery from the downturn triggered by the Middle East conflict. Despite the weaker near-term outlook, UBS noted that expectations for long-term economic growth and inflation remained broadly unchanged from those reported in March. Meanwhile, assessments of current economic conditions improved, with the current conditions gauge rising to +2.8 in June from -2.8 in May.

【Germany June Ifo business climate in line with forecasts; firms' confidence edges up】Germany's June Ifo business climate rose to 85.6, matching market forecasts. After plunging in April to its lowest since Oct 2022, business sentiment has continued a modest rebound from May into June, but the recovery remains limited and the index sits in its weakest range since early 2025. The worst impact of the Middle East shock appears to have eased as energy-price pressures abate, providing short-term support to sentiment. Both the current assessment and expectations components improved, offering some hope for an H2 pickup in the German economy. However, stagflation risks persist: if the Strait of Hormuz situation remains unchanged, the global economy will need to adapt to a new normal, and that adjustment could keep euro-area activity under further pressure before any sustained improvement.

German Business Morale Improves — Germany’s Ifo Business Climate Index increased to 85.6 in June 2026, the highest in three months, compared to an upwardly revised 85 in May and in line with market expectations. “Firms perceive the business environment as less uncertain. German companies are hoping for geopolitical tensions to ease”, Ifo's president Clemens Fuest said. The current conditions gauge rose to 87 from 86.1, above forecasts of 86. The expectations index also improved to 84.1 from 83.9, but fell short of expectations of 85.

Taiwan Retail Sales Expand at Softer Pace in May — Retail sales in Taiwan rose by 4.9% year-on-year in May 2026, easing from a 5.2% increase in April. Growth remained positive across most categories but generally moderated, led by general merchandise stores (5.5% vs 7.2% in April), textiles and clothing (8.1% vs 14.1%), pharmaceutical and medical goods (5.9% vs 6.6%), cultural and recreation goods (9.0% vs 10.6%), information and communications equipment (4.3% vs 11.0%), non-store retail (5.4% vs 5.7%), and e-shop and mail-order houses (8.7% vs 9.1%). Meanwhile, sales of food, beverages and tobacco slipped into contraction (-0.2% vs 3.7%), while sales of motor vehicles, motorcycles and related parts remained negative despite a softer decline (-0.9% vs -4.6%). In contrast, growth accelerated for household appliances (6.0% vs 3.7%), construction materials (10.0% vs 4.7%), fuel and related products (16.9% vs 7.1%), and other retail sales (10.0% vs 6.6%). On a monthly basis, retail sales rose 2.6% in May, reversing a 0.3% decline in April.

【榮耀產品線總裁方飛：將於今年7月釋出下一代終端作業系統AgenticOS】MWC26上海今日開幕，在“Al落地：自主時代”環節，榮耀產品線總裁方飛發表主題演講。她表示，移動終端是AI走進真實生活的必經之路，將不再是應用的容器，而是智慧體的舞臺。移動終端正在迎來以AI為原點的正規化躍遷，重構產品形態、重構人機互動、重構系統體驗。在此背景下，她透露，榮耀打造了以人為中心的下一代終端作業系統AgenticOS，具備四大特性：意圖驅動，以意圖為中心，而非以應用為中心；自然互動，以感官為入口，聲音、手勢、眼神、動作都是輸入；主動智慧，以Agent為核心，主動規劃、主動服務、主動執行；天生跨端，以一腦排程萬端，多裝置、多Agent協同。方飛預告，AgenticOS將於今年7月正式釋出。（新浪科技）

Sterling Eases to 7-Month Low — The British pound weakened below $1.32, nearing its lowest level in seven months, as investors balanced easing political uncertainty with weaker UK economic data. Investors welcomed signs that a prolonged Labour leadership contest was becoming less likely after Keir Starmer announced his resignation. Andy Burnham is now seen as the leading candidate to replace him, with backing from former health secretary Wes Streeting reducing the risk of a drawn-out leadership battle. On the economic front, June flash PMI data showed a weaker picture, with the composite index falling to a 14-month low of 49.4, below expectations and signalling a second consecutive month of contraction. Rising input costs and accelerating services inflation continue to complicate the Bank of England’s policy outlook.

【Riksbank: Middle East conflict raises inflation risk, increases odds of a rate hike this year】Minutes from the Riksbank policy meeting show that, despite low underlying inflation and a fragile recovery, the Middle East conflict has raised the likelihood of a rate hike before year-end. Governor Erik Thedéen said the conflict's effects are already visible in Swedish and foreign price‑pressure indicators, though long‑term implications remain uncertain. He added the bank is slightly tightening policy; adjustments to date are small but can be quickly scaled up or down depending on the evolution of inflation risks.

UK 10-Year Gilt Yield Falls to Over 2-Month Low — The UK 10-year gilt yield fell to 4.736%, extending declines for a third session to an over two-month low, as weaker UK flash PMI data reinforced expectations of slower economic momentum and reduced the likelihood of Bank of England rate hikes. Political uncertainty also eased after Prime Minister Keir Starmer announced his resignation, with Andy Burnham emerging as the leading candidate to replace him. Attention now turns to Burnham’s potential policy agenda, cabinet choices and the implications for public finances. If no major challenger emerges, Burnham could take office as early as July 17. Meanwhile, June PMI data showed the UK economy remained under pressure, with the composite index falling to 49.4, below expectations and signalling contraction for a second consecutive month. Services activity weakened, while manufacturing held up better. Rising input costs and persistent services inflation remain key concerns for the Bank of England.

【塔利班再掌權來首次 阿代表團訪布魯塞爾會歐盟官員】歐盟官員與阿富汗政府代表團23日首次在歐盟總部所在地比利時布魯塞爾會談，討論遣返有刑事犯罪記錄或被視為危險人員的阿富汗移民事宜。阿富汗塔利班2021年再次執掌政權，至今未獲歐盟正式承認。今年1月，阿富汗政府官員與歐盟官員在阿首都喀布林舉行會談。路透社等多家外媒報道，歐盟方面否認舉行這些會談等同於承認塔利班政權，但認為與阿富汗“事實當局”展開“有限磋商”有助於推動解決阿富汗移民問題。歐盟委員會發言人23日說，歐委會和15個歐盟成員國的官員參加當天的會談，與阿方官員就遣返“犯重罪”和“具有安全威脅”的阿富汗移民展開磋商。（新華社）
【轉行買方 招商證券首席策略分析師張夏內部調動至招商資管】市場傳聞招商證券首席策略分析師張夏離職，記者獨家獲悉，張夏並非行業跳槽，而是內部調動至招商資管，任職為投資崗。目前，中證協官網已無法查詢到張夏的執業註冊資訊。公開資料顯示，張夏於2011年加入招商證券，擁有超過15年的賣方研究經驗。

【現代投資：2025年營收59.34億元 淨利潤同比增長48.21%】現代投資公告稱，2025年營收59.34億元，同比增長6.41%；淨利潤5.08億元，同比增長48.21%。分行業看，道路運輸業營收26.99億元，同比降5.96%；商品貿易營收26.65億元，同比增27.89%。“25現代01”債券發行規模10億元，募集資金已按約定用途使用完畢，2025年3月4日已完成付息。發行人經營穩定，償債意願和能力未發生重大不利變化。
【綜藝股份：變更董事會秘書 顧政巍離任吳涵接任】綜藝股份公告稱，近日，公司董事會收到董事、副總經理、董事會秘書顧政巍辭任報告，因工作調整，她於2026年6月24日不再擔任該職務，繼續任董事、副總經理，其持有公司10萬股。同日，公司第十二屆董事會第九次會議同意聘任吳涵為董事會秘書，任期至第十二屆董事會任期屆滿。吳涵具備相關資質和經驗，曾擔任公司董事長助理。

【大摩：人形機器人行業可能將更加註重商業化】摩根士丹利在一份研究報告中表示，人形機器人行業可能會更加註重商業化。摩根士丹利觀察到，上半年該行業發展迅速，初步應用場景已擴大到生產線、分揀線和商業服務等領域。報告稱，近期案例包括人形機器人在工廠和物流環境中工作的持續直播，以及在無人零售店和互動式商業服務中的進一步推廣。摩根士丹利補充，隨著商業驗證的推進，上半年開始測試的專案有望在下半年開始轉化為實際應用。

【一位潛在對手排除參選 伯納姆入主唐寧街之路更加通暢】安迪·伯納姆幾乎可以肯定將成為英國下一任首相。曾被視為潛在競爭對手的達倫·瓊斯已表示，不會發起對領導權的爭奪。大臣瓊斯也是即將卸任首相基爾·斯塔默的盟友，他週三接受天空新聞採訪時排除了參與競選的可能性，並表示他相信伯納姆將成為下一任首相。前曼徹斯特市長伯納姆現在越來越有可能成為唯一一位被提名接替斯塔默擔任工黨領袖的候選人，如果沒有競爭對手，他可能在7月中旬就任首相。

【三菱日聯：美聯儲與歐洲央行分化拖累歐元兌美元】三菱日聯銀行的Lee Hardman在一份報告中表示，近期市場對美聯儲和歐洲央行政策預期的分化，正推動歐元兌美元跌至一年低點。“雖然美國利率市場已開始反映美聯儲多次加息的預期，但歐元區利率市場對歐洲央行進一步加息必要性的信心有所減弱。“他表示，週二公佈的歐元區採購經理人調查進一步推動了歐洲央行加息預期的降溫，該調查凸顯出該地經濟因能源價格衝擊而放緩。相比之下，美國經濟受到的影響似乎較小，週二公佈的美國PMI資料更為強勁。歐元最低跌至1.1351美元。

【國泰海通：予長江證券“增持”評級，經紀業務持續受益、ROE突出】國泰海通證券研報指出，長江證券作為零售票賦深厚、投研特色鮮明的中型券商，湖北國資入主以來科創資源票賦支撐公司科創投資業務加速成長，疊加市場提振下二級自營、經紀業務持續受益、ROE突出，給予2026年1.4x目標PB，對應目標價9.82元/股，給予“增持”評級。長江證券綜合實力位列行業中游，零售票賦深厚、投研特色鮮明、ROE行業領先。26年部分儲備專案進入IPO通道，疊加早期投資專案廣合科技2Q估值修復、有望於二季度為長江貢獻較多投資收益。

【機構：6月迄今霍爾木茲海峽原油運輸量恢復至正常水平的三分之一左右】Kpler的Yui Torikata表示，6月迄今，透過霍爾木茲海峽的原油運輸量已恢復至正常水平的三分之一左右，在美國和伊朗簽署諒解備忘錄之後，已確認的供應量達到約480萬桶/日。該分析師稱，這一復甦是由伊朗恢復出口、滯留在海灣地區三個多月的非伊朗貨物獲釋，以及在沒有主動跟蹤訊號的情況下執行的船隻繼續活動共同推動的。伊朗油輪在航行期間越來越多地恢復廣播其位置，這標誌著正逐漸迴歸更透明的交易活動。與此同時，自6月18日以來，滯留在霍爾木茲海峽內的非伊朗船隻上約3,500萬桶石油已駛離該水道。然而，Torikata表示，航運狀況尚未完全恢復正常，儘管緊張局勢有所緩解，但仍有大量非伊朗貨物在暗中透過該水道。
【退市創興：釋出股票進入退市整理期交易第五次風險提示】退市創興公告稱，公司股票於2026年6月8日進入退市整理期，預計最後交易日期為6月29日，交易15個交易日，期滿後5個交易日內上交所將對公司股票摘牌。退市整理期首個交易日無漲跌幅限制，此後每日漲跌幅限制為10%。期間公司不籌劃或實施重大資產重組。公司提醒投資者及時了結相關業務，司法凍結業務提前辦續凍，注意投資風險。
【同益股份：尼龍加纖板材已在機器人外殼產品中應用】同益股份6月24日在互動平臺稱，公司在機器人領域可以提供高效能的高分子複合材料板棒材。目前，公司自主研發的高強度、高韌性尼龍加纖板材已實現在機器人外殼產品中應用。

【吉太航空科技完成近億元A輪融資】近日，吉太航空科技（蘇州）有限公司完成A輪融資，本輪融資總額近億元人民幣，由公司老股東容億投資領投，蘇州創新投資集團、松禾資本、物產中大投資聯合跟投。本輪資金將主要用於公司大飛機航電與低空航電兩大業務線的產品研發投入、適航取證推進與市場拓展。

【上海誼眾：擬以3000萬元-5000萬元回購公司股份】上海誼眾公告，公司實際控制人、董事長周勁松提議公司以自有資金透過集中競價交易方式回購股份，回購資金總額不低於3000萬元（含），不超過5000萬元（含），回購價格不高於董事會透過回購決議前30個交易日公司股票交易均價的150%。回購的股份將在披露回購結果暨股份變動公告12個月後透過集中競價交易方式出售，如公司未能在股份回購結果暨股份變動公告日後三年內轉讓完畢，尚未轉讓的已回購股份將予以登出。回購期限自股東會審議透過之日起3個月內。具體方案以董事會審議透過的回購股份方案為準。

【新天科技：股東費戰波解除質押1億股股份】新天科技公告稱，股東費戰波為控股股東或第一大股東及其一致行動人，於2026年6月23日解除質押股份1億股，佔其所持股份比例23.84%，佔公司總股本比例8.66%。截至公告披露日，費戰波及一致行動人累計質押股份8000萬股，佔其所持股份比例15.40%，佔公司總股本比例6.93%。費戰波所質押股份不存在平倉風險，對公司無不利影響。

Poland Jobless Rate Hits 5-Month Low — Poland’s registered unemployment rate edged down to 5.9% in May 2026, the lowest in five months, from 6.0% in April. The latest figure came in line with market expectations. The number of unemployed persons dropped by 18.4 thousand from a month earlier to 915.9 thousand, with women representing 49.1% of the total. The majority of unemployed individuals were not entitled to unemployment benefits, accounting for 87.3% of the total. Additionally, 367.1 thousand had been out of work for more than a year. Compared with May 2025, the jobless rate was 0.8 percentage points higher, having stood at 5.1% a year ago. Meanwhile, reported job vacancies at the end of the month fell slightly by 0.4 thousand to 40.5 thousand.

【國務院臺辦發言人陳斌華答記者問】問:據瞭解，近日上海、福建旅遊業者申請赴島內旅遊踩線被臺灣有關方面駁回。請問對此有何評論?

答:為貫徹落實十項促進兩岸交流合作的政策措施，積極推動上海、福建居民赴島內個人遊試點，兩地旅遊業界迅速組織從業者踩線團申請入島實地考察線路、對接島內旅遊業者。這是大陸方面順應兩岸民眾的共同期盼，積極務實推動兩岸民間往來、助力臺灣觀光產業的善意舉措。 踩線是旅遊開放前常規行業操作，目的是對接食宿、景點、接待流程，屬於純民間、純業務交流。但民進黨當局卻單方面丟擲“必須先經觀光‘小兩會’協商”作為前置門檻，直接駁回踩線團入島申請，是典型的政治操弄、人為設障。 眾所周知，《海峽兩岸關於大陸居民赴臺旅遊協議》是海協會和海基會在“九二共識”基礎上協商並簽訂。民進黨當局拒不承認“九二共識”，其觀光主管部門甚至叫囂“臺灣與中國透過‘小兩會’進行雙邊協商”，充分反映出其否定“九二共識”、破壞兩岸交流、推行“臺獨”分裂的本質和圖謀。 必須強調指出的是，民進黨當局倒行逆施，無視臺灣旅遊業者生存困境與普通民眾民生訴求，人為掐斷旅遊市場復甦通道，以各種站不住腳的理由拒絕大陸居民赴島內旅遊，以犧牲臺灣民眾切身利益來謀取政治私利，正日益引起島內旅遊業者和民眾的強烈憤慨。相信廣大臺灣同胞能夠看清民進黨當局阻限兩岸交流交往的險惡用心，堅決反對民進黨當局違背民意的惡行。

【博瑞醫藥：聘任財務總監、補選非獨立董事並調整委員會委員】博瑞醫藥公告稱，2026年6月23日召開的第四屆董事會第二十二次會議，審議透過多項議案。同意聘任詹春雷為財務總監，任期至第四屆董事會任期屆滿；補選謝道生為第四屆董事會非獨立董事，尚需股東會審議；若補選議案透過，將調整董事會專門委員會委員。調整後，戰略發展與ESG、提名、薪酬與考核、審計委員會人數分別為5人、3人、3人、3人，各設召集人，任期至第四屆董事會任期屆滿（謝道生自股東會審議透過起算）。

DAX Down for 2nd Day — The DAX 40 fell about 0.5% to below 24,800 on Wednesday, extending the prior session's losses, which were driven by a global tech selloff. Traders awaited Micron’s quarterly results for insight into the semiconductor outlook, while divergent signals persisted over US-Iran negotiations despite indications of improved traffic through the strategic waterway. Aerospace and defense stocks weighed heavily on the broader index. Rheinmetall plunged over 13% as reports emerged that Germany is considering scrapping plans for its largest warship since World War II in favor of acquiring eight smaller frigates from thyssenkrupp Marine Systems (TKMS). However, MTU Aero Engines climbed over 3% after JP Morgan reiterated its "Buy" rating. Brenntag and Zalando were also among the top gainers, rising more than 2% each. Chipmakers attempted a rebound, with Infineon Technologies up around 1%. Deutsche Post advanced 0.6% after an earlier decline following mixed results from FedEx.

French Stocks Hover Near Flatline — The CAC 40 hovered around the unchanged mark near 8,350 on Wednesday, extending a cautious tone after three consecutive session of losses as a broad technology selloff and and persistent Federal Reserve hawkishness kept investors on the sidelines. Investors also remained focused on US-Iran peace negotiations amid signs of improving shipping activity through the Strait of Hormuz. However, uncertainty persisted over whether Tehran would grant UN inspectors access to its nuclear facilities. Luxury heavyweights outperformed, with LVMH rising 2% and Hermès gaining 1.3%. Meanwhile, Thales fell 1.9% and Airbus slipped 0.2% as European aerospace and defense stocks came under pressure after Rheinmetall plunged on reports that the German government may withdraw funding for a new warship project.
【匯通達網路退出名下一公司】天眼查App顯示，近日，南昌贛翔網路科技有限公司發生工商變更，原股東匯通達網路股份有限公司退出，新增鄒麗為股東。該公司成立於2017年1月，註冊資本120萬人民幣，經營範圍包括電子產品、家用電器的批發、零售等。股東資訊顯示，該公司現由鄒麗、丁海雪共同持股。

FTSE 100 Trades Muted on Wednesday — The FTSE 100 traded flat to lower on Wednesday as minor losses among major oil and banking shares weighed on the index. Shell and BP dipped up to 1.1%, while banking giants HSBC, Lloyds, and Barclays shed between 0.3% and 0.8%, alongside declines in aerospace firms Rolls-Royce (-0.7%) and BAE Systems (-1.9%). Conversely, commercial property landlord Segro saw its shares surge over 15% after its board unequivocally rejected an all-share takeover proposal from American rival Prologis. Housebuilder Berkeley also advanced more than 5% after full-year operating profits beat expectations, though its update highlighted the operational difficulties developers face in meeting government housebuilding targets. Additionally, discount retailer B&M ticked up 0.5% following the appointment of former Asda executive Atheeq Akbar as its new chief financial officer.

【東亞藥業：2025年營收9.40億元 同比降21.54%】東亞藥業公告稱，2025年度，公司實現營業收入9.40億元，同比下降21.54%；淨虧損0.82億元。2025年末，公司總資產為33.38億元，較期初減少6.15%，歸屬於母公司所有者權益為18.06億元，較期初減少3.66%。此外，2023年7月6日發行的6.90億元“東亞轉債”，截至2025年12月31日，募集資金已使用完畢，全部專戶已登出。

FTSE MIB Extends Losses — The FTSE MIB fell to around 51,700 on Wednesday, extending its retreat from record levels and mirroring losses across its European peers. Defense contractor Leonardo dropped nearly 4%, tracking declines among regional counterparts amid reports that Germany is considering scrapping plans for its largest warship since World War II in favor of acquiring eight smaller frigates from TKMS. Most financial stocks also traded lower, including BPER Banca (-1.1%), Unipol Gruppo (-1.2%), Banca Mediolanum (-0.9%), and FinecoBank (-1.2%). On the flip side, gains were seen in Poste Italiane (+1.2%), Snam (+0.7%), STMicroelectronics (+0.7%), and Telecom Italia (+0.7%). Meanwhile, markets await updates on US-Iran negotiations and Micron's earnings results for further clues on the outlook for the semiconductor sector.

【賽升藥業：注射用甲磺酸萘莫司他藥品註冊申請獲受理】賽升藥業公告，公司近日收到國家藥品監督管理局下發的注射用甲磺酸萘莫司他藥品註冊受理通知書。該藥品用於改善胰腺炎的急性症狀，治療彌散性血管內凝血綜合徵（DIC），以及防止有出血性病變或出血傾向的患者血液體外迴圈時灌流血液的凝固。甲磺酸萘莫司他為新型的蛋白酶抑制劑，對胰蛋白酶、補體系統、凝血纖溶系統及血小板凝集具有強力且廣泛的抑制作用。藥品註冊申請已獲得受理，將報送國家藥品監督管理局藥品審評中心進行審評審批。
【至純科技：控股股東蔣淵解除質押36萬股】至純科技公告稱，2026年6月23日，控股股東蔣淵解除原有質押36萬股，佔其所持公司股份的0.46%，佔公司股份總數的0.09%。本次解質前，蔣淵累計質押2866萬股，佔其所持公司股份的36.34%，佔公司股份總數的7.48%。解質後，蔣淵累計質押2830萬股，佔其所持公司股份的35.88%，佔公司股份總數的7.39%。本次解除質押的股份暫無再質押計劃。
【晨曦航空：取得1項發明專利證書】晨曦航空公告，公司於近日收到國家智慧財產權局頒發的一項發明專利證書，專利名稱為“慣導裝置的標定方法、裝置、裝置及儲存介質”，專利型別為發明專利，專利申請日為2024年02月29日，授權公告日為2026年06月19日，專利權人為公司。該證書的取得不會對公司近期生產經營產生重大影響，但有利於公司進一步完善智慧財產權體系，保持技術領先。
【珈偉新能：董事孟宇亮因個人原因離任】珈偉新能公告稱，公司董事會近日收到董事孟宇亮的辭職報告，其因個人工作安排調整，辭去董事及相關專門委員會委員職務，離任後不在公司及控股子公司任職。其原定任期至2028年7月2日，截至公告披露日，未持股，無未履行承諾事項。因辭職致審計委員會成員低於法定人數，其將繼續履職至補選產生新委員。公司將盡快完成補選。

【2026年“一帶一路”貿易投資論壇成功舉辦】6月23日，第四屆鏈博會期間，2026年“一帶一路”貿易投資論壇在京舉辦。中國貿促會會長、中國國際商會會長任鴻斌，絲綢之路商務理事會中國委員會主席單位、中國交通建設集團有限公司董事長宋海良等出席開幕式並致辭。任鴻斌表示，中國“十五五”規劃綱要對高質量共建“一帶一路”作出重要部署，提出加強與共建國家戰略對接，拓展新興領域務實合作，向世界宣示了中國以高水平開放促進共同繁榮的堅定決心。中國貿促會、中國國際商會將進一步發揮橋樑紐帶作用，搭建鏈博會等高質量平臺，豐富服務供給，助力企業在共建“一帶一路”合作中開拓發展空間，為推動共建“一帶一路”行穩致遠、攜手共建人類命運共同體作出新的更大貢獻。南亞聯盟工商會主席錢迪·拉吉·達卡爾、塞爾維亞工商會主席馬爾科·查戴日、寮國國家工商會會長吳迪·蘇萬那馮、英中商業發展中心主席約翰·麥克萊恩、馬來西亞-中國商務理事會主席丹斯里拿督盧成全上議員、泰中商務委員會主席邱威功等發言。來自共建國家和地區政商學界代表圍繞“聚焦基建與民生，共建高質量互聯互通”“促進貿易與投資，推動全球化合作發展”等議題深入開展交流研討，凝聚了廣泛合作共識。本次論壇由中國國際商會主辦，主題為“連結開放新格局 共築絲路新未來”。來自“一帶一路”共建國家政府部門代表、工商界領袖、國際組織負責人、專家學者等200餘人出席論壇。（中國貿促）

【金價承壓，受美元走強和加息擔憂影響】隨著美元走強和對今年加息的預期不斷升溫拖累了市場情緒，金價下跌，延續了上一交易日的跌勢。盛寶銀行的分析師表示：“由於能源價格下跌緩解了對通貨膨脹的擔憂，不斷上漲的美國國債提供的支撐有限。“與此同時，“黃金與標普500指數異常強烈的正相關性繼續拖累價格，將該金屬推入4,000-4,100美元的關鍵支撐區。“在歐洲市場早盤交易中，紐約期金下跌1.2%，報每盎司4,098.70美元。與此同時，美元指數上漲0.1%，至101.55，使得以美元計價的大宗商品對海外買家來說更加昂貴。

RBA Sees More Work to Tame Inflation: Deputy Gov. Hauser — The Reserve Bank of Australia still has more work to do to bring inflation back to target, Deputy Governor Andrew Hauser said in a speech. He described price growth as "too high," but noted that lower global oil prices from a potential easing of tensions between the U.S., Israel, and Iran would be a positive development. Hauser explained that the board began raising interest rates in February after concluding that demand was exceeding the economy's supply capacity by more than expected, fueling inflation. He said operating on the steeper part of the Phillips curve meant timely policy tightening could curb inflation with a relatively smaller impact on unemployment. "Timely policy steps to reduce inflationary pressures, of the kind we have taken, should also have a proportionally smaller unemployment cost," he said. Headline inflation slowed to 4.0% in May while underlying inflation accelerated to 3.6%, remaining above the central bank's 2%–3% target range.

【單籤最高盈利27.2萬元！N臻寶成年內第二隻首日“十倍股”】今日，半導體裝置零部件股臻寶科技正式登陸科創板，首日漲幅高達1212.84%，成為年內第二隻首日“十倍股”，漲幅僅次於長進光子（1510.52%）。按單籤500股計算，打新投資者單籤盈利約27.02萬元，在年內新股首日盈利榜上位列第三，僅次於長進光子與聯訊儀器（兩股首日盈利均超30萬元）。若以盤中1222%的最大漲幅測算，單籤最大浮盈可達27.22萬元，這一資料在A股史上“最賺錢新股”排行榜中位列第六位。受首日大漲提振，臻寶科技今日收盤價達到585元，超越新易盛、長飛光纖、茂萊光學等一眾人氣標的，躍居A股股價排行榜第20名。
【建元信託：控股股東4.18%股份解除凍結 剩餘被凍結股份歸零】建元信託公告稱，公司控股股東上海砥安持有公司49.52億股，佔總股本50.30%。其持有的4.11億股股份於2026年6月23日全部解除凍結，佔其持股總數的8.31%，佔公司總股本的4.18%。本次解除凍結後，上海砥安所持公司股份不存在被凍結情形。

【外交部介紹王毅出席金磚安代會情況：金磚國家加強安全事務對話合作正當其時】6月24日，外交部發言人郭嘉昆主持例行記者會。有記者提問，日前，中共中央政治局委員、中央外辦主任王毅出席了在印度舉行的第十六次金磚國家安全事務高階代表會議。發言人能否介紹更多情況？郭嘉昆表示，6月22日至23日，王毅主任出席在印度新德里舉行的第十六次金磚國家安全事務高階代表會議，並同莫迪總理進行友好交流，同多國代表團團長舉行雙邊會見。此次會議是在美以伊戰事由衝突轉向對話的背景下舉行。王毅主任表示，這場百餘天的衝突嚴重衝擊地區和國際局勢，給各方帶來四點深刻啟示，包括維護國際規則的重要性，尊重國家主權的重要性，樹立新安全觀的重要性，把握新戰爭形態的重要性。面對傳統與非傳統安全威脅相互交織，“金磚國家”加強安全事務對話合作正當其時。王毅主任指出，“金磚國家”合作已經走過20個春秋，日益成為護和平、促發展、守正義的中堅力量。當前國際格局發生複雜深刻變化，“金磚國家”要以“金磚擔當”捍衛國際秩序、以“金磚共識”破解安全困局、以“金磚行動”應對全球性挑戰、以“金磚智慧”完善新興領域治理。王毅主任表示，此次會議形成的重要共識是支援維護多邊主義，發出的共同聲音是金磚和全球南方堅持獨立自主，加強團結互助，確定的明確方向是進一步用好金磚安代會這一機制，就重大國際和地區熱點問題保持溝通協調，不斷豐富“大金磚”合作內涵。2027年中國將接任金磚輪值主席國，中方期待同金磚夥伴一道，積極踐行習近平主席提出的構建人類命運共同體理念和四大全球倡議，以發展促繁榮，以安全保穩定，以文明增互信，以治理求公正，共同開闢和平與繁榮的未來。

【哈藥股份：控股股東質押2.56億股股份 累計質押比例達66.47%】哈藥股份公告稱，公司控股股東哈藥集團將其所持2.56億股公司股份辦理質押登記，佔其所持股份的21.82%，佔公司總股本的10.16%。截至本次質押完成後，哈藥集團累計質押股份7.80億股，佔其所持公司股份總數的66.47%，佔公司總股本的30.96%。本次質押所融資金用於自身生產經營，哈藥集團資信、財務狀況良好，不存在未來半年及一年內到期的質押股份，質押風險可控，對公司生產經營等無影響。

【近期科技股遭拋售之際，比特幣僅略有回升】在近期全球科技股遭遇拋售之際，比特幣在週二觸及12天低點後僅略有回升。IG分析師在一份報告中表示，隨著市場預計美聯儲將在未來幾個月加息，金融狀況收緊，加上對人工智慧(AI)領域債務融資支出的擔憂，令科技股承壓。倫敦證券交易所集團(LSEG)的資料顯示，受上週美聯儲會議和近期強勁資料的推動，市場目前反映出9月份加息機率達90%的預期。倫敦證券交易所集團(LSEG)的資料顯示，比特幣在週二跌至61,921美元的低點後，微升0.5%，至62,686美元。自6月5日觸及59,125美元的20個月低點以來，比特幣一直難以實現有意義的回升，在窄幅區間內交易。

【中方回應日本阻撓設立慰安婦雕像】6月24日，外交部發言人郭嘉昆主持例行記者會。 有記者提問，近日，泰國媒體刊登文章《“慰安婦”不能被抹去》，提及二戰時期日本在亞洲多地建“慰安所”、形成制度化軍事性奴役，而泰國、菲律賓等地區國家出於種種原因，不願正視甚至刻意弱化這一歷史，阻礙了真相的世代傳承。前不久，紐西蘭奧克蘭市曾計劃設立一座“慰安婦”主題雕像，但在日方施壓下叫停。近年來，美國、加拿大、德國、澳大利亞、菲律賓也都出現過日方阻撓設立“慰安婦”雕像的情況。請問發言人對此有何評論？ 郭嘉昆表示，中方多次就慰安婦問題闡明立場。強徵慰安婦是日本軍國主義對外侵略擴張期間犯下的嚴重反人類罪行，是對包括中國、朝鮮半島、東南亞等各國人民基本人權的粗暴踐踏。累累惡行，鐵證如山，不容否認。 郭嘉昆指出，不久前去世的河野洋平先生曾作為日本內閣官房長官就慰安婦問題發表正式談話，承認日本政府責任，表示反省和道歉。然而長期以來，日本一些勢力妄圖否認甚至篡改侵略歷史，對慰安婦問題輕描淡寫，剝奪受害者尋求正義和獲得賠償的權利，不斷在受害者傷口上撒鹽。日本政府還阻撓有關國家設立慰安婦紀念雕像，引發民間團體和各界民眾強烈憤慨。不久前聯合國人權專家對慰安婦問題表達嚴重關切，呼籲日本正式道歉，充分賠償。我們敦促日本執政當局正視侵略歷史，真誠認罪謝罪，停止掩蓋真相，壓制正義之聲，停止“再軍事化”的逆流妄動。 郭嘉昆說，我們也注意到，聯合國消除對婦女歧視委員會，還敦促菲律賓將慰安婦問題納入主流教育。歷史是最好的清醒劑，各受害國更應樹立正確二戰史觀，守護歷史真相，防止悲劇重演，共護亞太地區來之不易的和平穩定。（北京日報）

【How will China ensure U.S. compliance and full implementation of the U.S.-Iran memorandum? Foreign Ministry responds】June 24 — China's Foreign Ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun said Beijing favors resolving regional disputes through dialogue, opposes the use or threat of force, and views the U.S.-Iran memorandum of understanding (MoU)—under which both parties pledge to respect each other's sovereignty and territorial integrity, refrain from military action and avoid interference in internal affairs—as a positive signal that should be jointly maintained and implemented. Guo said China maintains an impartial stance, supports efforts conducive to peace, backs Iran's sovereignty, security and national dignity, and supports Iran improving ties with Gulf and regional states. He added China is willing, under Xi Jinping's four-point proposal, to provide assistance in its own way and play a constructive role in restoring regional peace and stability.

【中方如何確保美國遵守承諾、使美伊諒解備忘錄全面履行？外交部回應】6月24日，外交部發言人郭嘉昆主持例行記者會。針對記者提問，郭嘉昆表示，中方始終認為，應透過對話談判解決地區熱點和各方分歧，反對使用武力或用武力相威脅。美伊簽署諒解備忘錄，承諾尊重彼此主權和領土完整，不再發動任何軍事行動，避免干涉對方內政，對外發出了積極訊號，應共同加以維護和落實。中方始終秉持公正立場，支援一切有助於和平的努力，支援伊方維護主權、安全和民族尊嚴，支援伊朗改善同海灣各國及地區國家關係。中方願根據習近平主席“四點主張”精神，繼續以自己的方式提供協助，為早日恢復地區和平安寧發揮建設性作用。（澎湃）

【夏季達沃斯論壇在大連開幕，外交部：真誠歡迎各國企業來華投資興業】6月24日，外交部發言人郭嘉昆主持例行記者會。有記者提問，以“規模化創新”為主題的第十七屆夏季達沃斯論壇正在大連舉行。今天上午，李強總理在論壇開幕式上發表致辭，引發與會各國嘉賓的熱烈反響，各方高度肯定中國創新成果，看好“中國機遇2.0”，期待加強同中國的創新合作。發言人能否進一步介紹有關情況？

郭嘉昆表示，今天上午，第十七屆夏季達沃斯論壇在大連開幕，國務院總理李強出席論壇開幕式並致辭。李強總理在致辭中結合中國經濟發展實踐，分享了中國創新的故事，以及對全球創新合作的思考。

李強總理表示，“十五五”伊始，中國經濟在應變局中開新局。在國際形勢愈發動盪不安背景下，中國經濟不懼風雨、奮楫破浪，呈現出“穩、新、活、融”的一幅多維圖景，展現了堅韌向前、蓬勃向好的開局之勢，為不確定性增多的世界注入了寶貴的確定性。

李強總理指出，創新驅動是中國經濟長期向好、行穩致遠的關鍵密碼。中國的創新是苦練內功“拼”出來的，是千行百業“用”出來的，是厚植生態“育”出來的。近期，國際上不少機構媒體提到“中國機遇2.0”，中國在提供更大市場紅利的同時，還透過科技進步與產業升級，為全球提供越來越多的創新紅利。對各國企業而言，“中國機遇2.0”意味著全方位的創新賦能、高收益的投資機會。對全球發展而言，“中國機遇2.0”意味著更可及的先進技術、更普惠的成果共享。事實有力證明，中國的新興領域技術和產品帶給世界的不是衝擊而是機遇，不是威脅而是賦能。

李強總理表示，創新合作是破解全球增長困境的必然選擇。各方應當深化聯通協作，共建開放型世界經濟，維護全球產供鏈穩定暢通，更加廣泛地凝聚創新合力。堅持科技向善，健全人工智慧等領域全球治理制度規則、提升監管效能，更加有效地推進共同治理。中國將進一步擴大市場準入，持續打造一流營商環境，真誠歡迎各國企業來華投資興業，更多分享中國發展新機遇。

【歐洲股市漲跌互現，防務股下跌而科技股企穩】在交投清淡的早盤交易中，歐洲股指漲跌互現。隨著全球科技股暴跌勢頭有所減弱，歐洲斯托克600指數持平，但隨著風向標萊茵金屬大幅下跌，防務股走低。有報道稱德國政府將撤銷對一艘新軍艦的資金支援，這家防務巨頭股價暴跌近12%。該股拖累德國DAX指數，該指數下跌0.5%。英國富時100指數走平，因為軟體和防務股的疲軟被房地產和房屋建築板塊的強勢所抵消。與此同時，隨著LVMH集團大漲2.2%，奢侈品股的上漲提振了巴黎的法國CAC 40指數，該指數上漲0.35%。半導體權重較大的荷蘭AEX指數微升0.1%，因阿斯麥在上一交易日大幅下跌後上漲0.5%。義大利富時MIB指數和西班牙IBEX 35指數均下跌約0.3%。

Czech Republic Consumer Morale Strengthens in June — The consumer confidence indicator in the Czech Republic rose by 3.1 points to 106.5 in June 2026 from 103.4 in the previous month. The increase was supported by improved expectations for the general economic situation over the next 12 months, as the share of consumers anticipating a deterioration in the domestic economy decreased. Sentiment regarding personal finances also strengthened, with more households expecting an improvement in their financial situation over the coming year, while the proportion of respondents reporting their current financial situation as worse than a year earlier remained unchanged. Meanwhile, the share of consumers not planning major purchases over the next 12 months declined slightly from May. Concerns about rising prices and further increases in unemployment were broadly unchanged from the previous month.

【外媒：梅洛尼與特朗普突然“翻臉”後，義大利試圖“降調”緩和關係】美國總統特朗普日前在接受採訪時稱義大利總理梅洛尼在七國集團（G7）峰會期間“央求合影”，雙方因此發生摩擦並公開互嗆。據美國彭博社、英國路透社等媒體報道，事件發生後，義大利方面目前試圖“降調”緩和關係。彭博社稱，義大利副總理兼外長塔亞尼試圖修復與美國的關係，稱意美兩國應努力緩和緊張形勢。“這並非徹底決裂。”塔亞尼在23日的採訪中表示，義大利與美國的聯盟關係“可持續且不可或缺”。（環球網）

【BOT holds policy rate at 1.00%; reassessing economic risks from Middle East tensions】The Bank of Thailand kept its policy rate at 1.00%, in line with market expectations, and said it is reassessing economic risks from the Middle East conflict. While war-related risks have eased, uncertainty remains elevated. Several central banks, including the Fed, have taken a wait-and-see stance; Japan, Indonesia and the Philippines raised rates last week to offset conflict-related shocks. The BOT said pre-ceasefire cost shocks had squeezed firms, weakened household purchasing power and hit tourism through higher costs and travel constraints, and that lagged effects will continue to weigh on growth. It also flagged El Nifio-driven food supply risks and ongoing uncertainty from US tariff policy. Many economists expect the BOT to remain on hold for the rest of the year, maintaining an accommodative stance to support a still-fragile economy.

Brunei Trade Surplus Hits 12-Year High — Brunei’s trade surplus surged to BND 1.12 billion in April 2026 from BND 0.4 billion in the same month a year earlier. It was the largest amount since April 2014, as exports jumped 75.8% yoy to BND 2.06 billion, the highest since December 2009, boosted by strong gains in mineral fuels (83.1%) and chemicals (48.4%). Australia was the largest export destination, accounting for 32.8% of total shipments, followed by Singapore (16.0%), Japan (12.9%), China (11.2%), and Thailand (10.3%). Imports grew at a slower 21.6% to BND 0.94 billion, driven by a sharp rise in mineral fuel purchases (22.6%) and machinery and transport equipment (33.4%). Malaysia was the top source of imports, supplying 67.8% of total inbound shipments, ahead of Vietnam (6.0%), China (5.4%), the UK (4.2%), and the U.S. (2.6%). For the first four months of 2026, trade surplus widened to BND 2.69 billion from BND 1.86 billion in the same period last year, as exports climbed 23.3% while imports rose more slowly by 8.0%.

【美媒稱伊朗研讀《交易的藝術》以破解特朗普談判策略】伊朗外交官表示，由於特朗普行事風格與眾不同，他們一直在研讀特朗普與記者託尼·施瓦茨於1987年合著的《交易的藝術》。該書建議談判者提出極端且難以預測的要求，以製造焦慮，迫使對手作出讓步。伊朗談判代表曾告訴中間人，他們諮詢了一個心理學家團隊以幫助理解特朗普的思維方式，試圖預測特朗普對伊朗提議的公開反應。政治分析人士和調解人士表示，特朗普高調且強硬的表態迄今尚未從伊朗方面換取額外讓步。華盛頓智庫威爾遜中心伊朗問題專家穆罕默德·阿梅爾西表示：“特朗普正在運用《交易的藝術》中的策略，透過極端威脅來測試對方的決心。但伊朗人非常清楚他的策略。”而一位瞭解伊朗在瑞士外交談判情況的人士表示，伊朗談判團隊中並沒有心理學家，而且伊朗方面更傾向於避免從心理層面揣測特朗普的動機或決策。

【US media say Iran studied The Art of the Deal to decode Trump's negotiating tactics】The Wall Street Journal on the 23rd reported Iranian diplomats say they have been studying The Art of the Deal—which advocates extreme, unpredictable demands to create anxiety and force concessions—to understand Trump's negotiating style. Iranian negotiators told intermediaries they consulted a team of psychologists to help anticipate Trump's likely public reactions; a person familiar with Iran's talks in Switzerland said there were no psychologists on the team and Tehran prefers not to psychoanalyze Trump's motives. Political analysts and mediators say Trump's high-profile, hardline statements have so far not produced additional concessions. Mohammad Amersi of the Wilson Center said Trump is deploying those tactics to test opponents' resolve, but Iranians are aware of his approach.

Azerbaijan Holds Rates for 3rd Meeting — The Central Bank of the Republic of Azerbaijan kept its discount rate unchanged at 6.5% for a third consecutive meeting in June 2026, maintaining borrowing costs at the lowest level since September 2021. The interest rate corridor was also left intact, with the lower bound at 5.5% and the upper bound at 7.5%, as policymakers judged inflation risks to be broadly balanced. Annual inflation stood at 5.6% in May, while non-food inflation stayed relatively subdued. The central bank noted favorable foreign exchange market conditions, declining dollarization, and strong foreign currency inflows. External conditions also remained supportive, helped by higher energy prices and a stronger trade balance. However, policymakers warned that global inflation risks, including higher food, fertilizer, and transportation costs, could affect domestic prices. The bank reiterated that future policy decisions will depend on inflation dynamics, external developments, and overall macroeconomic conditions.

Czech Business Morale Hits 5-Month Low — The business confidence indicator in the Czech Republic fell to 99.8 in June 2026 from 100.0 in the previous month, marking its lowest level since January. The decline reflected weaker sentiment across several sectors, with confidence falling in trade (91.9 vs. 92.8 in May), selected services (102.2 vs. 102.4), and construction (111.4 vs. 117.9). In contrast, confidence in the industrial sector rose to 97.5 from 94.5, providing some support to the overall indicator.

【Strategist: Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix 2x ETFs face reality check】A Smartkarma report by a derivatives and quantitative strategist says 2x single-stock ETFs tracking Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix must rally roughly 33% to recover June 22 levels, implying the underlying shares need about a 16.5% rise. Both chipmakers fell double digits on Tuesday, knocking the linked ETFs down about 25%; the Samsung 2x ETF is down 5.4% since its May 27 launch. The report warns Korea’s single-stock 2x ETFs boost returns in trending markets but quickly erode value in high volatility, making them best suited to short-term tactical momentum trades.

Bank of Thailand Holds Rates as Expected — The Bank of Thailand left its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 1% at its June 2026 meeting, in line with market expectations and keeping borrowing costs at their lowest level since 2022. The Thai economy is now forecast to grow 2.3% in 2026 and 1.8% in 2027, with growth proving stronger than previously anticipated. The outlook is supported by robust merchandise exports, private investment linked to the technology and AI cycle, government measures aimed at cushioning the impact of the energy crisis, and improving conditions surrounding the Middle East conflict. Meanwhile, the central bank maintained its inflation outlook, projecting headline inflation to average 2.8% in 2026 and 1.4% in 2027. While recent price pressures have been driven by supply-side factors, officials expect inflation to moderate as these pressures gradually ease. The Committee also said it will continue to closely monitor the inflation outlook and related risks.

【UEDA says BOJ will raise rates further as underlying inflation nears 2%】BANK OF JAPAN Governor UEDA said Japan’s economy may slow but remains in a mild recovery and signaled further rate hikes as underlying inflation approaches 2%. He said the BOJ will continue raising rates based on economic, price and financial conditions, with timing and pace to be decided after careful assessment of baseline forecasts and risks and while gauging the impact of the Middle East conflict. UEDA noted recent tightening has left financial conditions still accommodative and supportive of activity, warned high oil prices could push underlying inflation above 2%, and said the BOJ is monitoring Middle East developments, profitability of AI-related investment and overseas non-bank financial activity for implications to Japan’s financial system, which he described as broadly stable. Remarks were read by Deputy Governor HIMINO.

【國家能源局：截至5月底我國電動汽車充電基礎設施（槍）總數達到2249.7萬個 同比增長44.9%】國家能源局釋出2026年5月全國電動汽車充電設施資料。根據國家充電設施監測服務平臺資料，截至2026年5月底，我國電動汽車充電基礎設施（槍）總數達到2249.7萬個，同比增長44.9%。其中，公共充電設施（槍）495.1萬個，同比增長25.9%，額定總功率達到2.42億千瓦，單槍平均功率約為48.89千瓦；私人充電設施（槍）1754.6萬個，同比增長51.4%，私人充電設施報裝用電容量達到1.51億千伏安。單槍平均功率約為48.89千瓦，同比增長8.9%，今年以來保持穩步增長態勢，場站快速補能服務能力持續提升。私人充電設施（槍）數量今年以來同比增速一直超過50%，家用充電設施快速發展。

【“開屏廣告沒了”上熱搜，23款App實測】6月23日晚，“開屏廣告沒了”登上微博熱搜，不少網友反映部分App啟動時那幾秒的開屏廣告不見了。記者實測23款生活、社交、購物、導航等App發現，17款沒看見開屏廣告，僅有6款依舊有開屏廣告。開屏廣告真的消失了嗎？記者首先測試導航類App，記者開啟百度地圖、高德地圖和騰訊地圖，三款軟體均無開屏廣告，一點即入，頁面直接顯示當前位置。記者又對20款常用的購物、社交類App進行了逐一測試。結果發現，貼吧、微博、知乎、大麥、芒果TV等6款App仍保留開屏廣告，而淘寶、京東、小紅書、拼多多、閒魚、抖音、大眾點評等14款App則清爽了不少，點開即達主頁，已看不到開屏廣告的蹤影。測試中記者還注意到，即便是同一款App，在不同裝置上也可能情況不同。以嗶哩嗶哩為例，記者用兩部手機同時點開，一部彈出的是帶有5秒倒計時的開屏廣告，另一部卻直接進入了主介面。（北京日報）

【曾毓群：固態電池技術路線現在只到了level 4 level 9是可以量產】在2026大連夏季達沃斯論壇上，寧德時代董事長曾毓群在“無電力，不智慧”論壇表示，固態電池的技術路線，如果是level 1-9的話，現在只到了level 4，level 9是可以量產。他表示，這是技術路線，還有產品路線，就是有沒有這麼多供應，產品做出來的可靠性安全性是不是能達到需求，第三個是商品路線，是做出來的東西到底市場上接受度怎麼樣，能不能賣的很多。 (半島晨報)

【CHINA'S LI at 2026 Summer Davos in Dalian urges deeper innovation cooperation, expanded market access and AI governance】June 24, Dalian — CHINA'S LI said innovation cooperation is essential to address global growth shortfalls, noting rapid technological progress, rising unpredictability, deeper innovation linkages and growing barriers. He called for deeper connectivity and cooperation to preserve an open world economy and stable, smooth global supply chains. Li urged adherence to technology-for-good principles and stronger global governance and regulatory frameworks for AI and related fields to improve regulatory effectiveness and joint oversight. He urged firms to lead on innovation and cooperation, and said China will further expand market access, continue building a top-tier business environment and welcomes foreign investment to share China’s development opportunities.

【South Korea foreign arrivals exceed 10.0 mln in 1H, record for period】YONHAP cited data from the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism on June 24 showing South Korea received over 10.0 mln foreign visitors in 1H, a record for the period; the 10 mln threshold was crossed roughly one month earlier than in 2023, when it was only reached in mid‑July. 【Reserve Bank of Australia deputy governor hauser: inflation still too high, more tightening needed】Reserve Bank of Australia deputy governor hauser said on Wednesday the bank still needs to do more to reduce inflation, which remains too high. He added that a resolution of Middle East tensions and a fall in global oil prices would be supportive for inflation. In a speech on the Phillips curve he said the board began raising rates in February because demand looked to be outstripping supply more than expected, pushing inflation up along the steep part of the curve, so policy tightening was necessary to ensure inflation cools gradually. He also said the steep Phillips curve implies timely policy measures can reduce inflation while imposing a relatively small rise in unemployment.

【韓國尋求MSCI發達市場地位的努力仍在繼續】MSCI明晟(MSCI)在最新的指數評估中未將韓國上調至發達市場地位，令市場希望落空。不過，此次評估對印尼而言算是一個勝利，該國避免了評級被下調。多年來，韓國一直試圖從MSCI明晟獲得發達市場稱號，並推出多項措施以改善市場準入，涵蓋賬戶和結算系統、英文資訊披露以及衍生品等領域。另一家指數提供商富時羅素(FTSE Russell)自2009年以來就將韓國歸為發達市場，但這個亞洲科技強國尚未贏得MSCI明晟的青睞。MSCI明晟在週二的一份評估中承認韓國政府為解決長期存在的關切所採取的措施。“然而，投資者已表示，根本問題尚未完全解決。”從2008年到2014年，MSCI明晟曾就韓國的潛在重新分類問題與市場參與者進行磋商。他們提出了市場準入問題，例如投資者ID系統的僵化、對實物轉讓和場外交易的限制，但韓元有限的離岸可兌換性成為一個主要障礙。

【統戰部：所謂新疆少數民族“強制遷徙”“強迫勞動”說法極其荒謬可笑】6月24日上午，國務院新聞辦公室舉行新聞釋出會，介紹《中華人民共和國民族團結進步促進法》和我國民族工作有關情況。有記者問：有些西方媒體報道，中國對新疆少數民族“強迫勞動”“強制遷徙”議題，而民族團結進步促進法在“促進交往交流交融”章節中明確保障跨區域就業創業公民的合法權利，請問如何評價這種將促進各民族共同發展的舉措與“強迫勞動”掛鉤的言論？中國法律如何保障各族勞動者在流動就業中的合法權益不受侵犯？中央統戰部副部長、國家民委主任陳瑞峰表示，民族團結進步促進法明確了保障跨區域就業創業公民的合法權益，這些法律規定集中體現在第二十五條，作出這樣的規定，目的是維護各族群眾平等發展權利、拓寬增收渠道、促進各民族交往交流交融，始終堅持完全自願、雙向選擇、依法合規、來去自由的核心原則。新疆勞動力轉移就業是尊重各族群眾意願前提下實施的，目的在於幫助各族群眾增加就業機會，提高經濟收入，完全是、純粹是在為新疆老百姓辦實事、做好事。所有外出就業的新疆群眾，全部都是基於改善家庭生活、提升自身技能的個人意願自主報名，根本不存在所謂的“強制遷徙”“強迫勞動”，此類說法是極其荒謬、極其可笑的。（央視新聞）

【東吳證券：維持卓勝微“買入”評級，射頻全棧佈局持續兌現】東吳證券研報指出，卓勝微芯卓產線構築核心壁壘，射頻全棧佈局持續兌現。2026年起公司L-PAMiD高階模組正式進入放量週期，該產品打破海外廠商長期壟斷，是業界首次實現全國產供應鏈的系列產品，疊加海外龍頭企業退出中國市場、地緣摩擦催化國產替代加速，公司有望承接市場份額，驅動該產品實現數倍增長。射頻格局最佳化、模組成勢放量、矽光蓄力進階，雙輪驅動業績與估值共振。公司深度受益海外巨頭退出帶來的份額遷移，基於測算，射頻業務模組收入佔比2028年有望升高至6成，矽光業務逐步貢獻收入，消費電子加光通訊成長結構漸顯。預計26-28年營業收入為40.96/50.01/61.83億元，歸母淨利潤-0.03/2.62/4.87億元，27-28年對應PE分別為233/125倍，維持“買入”評級。

【SPHBM4標準獲批，突破HBM封裝成本高昂的瓶頸】JEDEC制定並公佈了SPHBM4標準。SPHBM4是一項新的JEDEC標準，使用更少的訊號引腳、標準封裝和更經濟的基板，即可實現接近HBM4的效能。SPHBM4將訊號引腳數量減少到原來的五分之一，並透過將訊號速度提高至原來的四倍，緩解效能損失的問題。這樣一來，即使使用標準基板，也能實現與HBM相當的頻寬。記憶體晶片和計算晶片之間的連線距離也增加到 20 毫米。這種距離的增加有助於提升封裝內部的散熱效能。

【分析：圖表顯示美元兌新加坡元可能進一步走高】大華全球經濟與市場研究部的Quek Ser Leang在一份報告中表示，基於圖表分析，美元兌新加坡元可能進一步走高。該高階技術策略師指出，在週一和週五測試了1.2930新加坡元的水平後，美元在週二顯著升破該水平。該策略師表示，強勁的周線動能也預示著美元兌新加坡元在未來幾周將進一步走強。該策略師補充道，從目前水平來看，美元若突破1.3000新加坡元，可能會為進一步升向2025年11月高點1.3095新加坡元開啟通道。

【VLCC fixed at WS 897 as Persian Gulf tonnage shortage drives rate spike】A VLCC (~2.0 mln barrels) has been fixed to lift crude from the Persian Gulf to India at WS 897 — about 897% of the Worldscale benchmark — brokers said, reflecting a severe regional shortage of available ballast tonnage. The vessel was supplied by Korean owner Sinokor Group and the booking was priced on a Persian Gulf–Singapore route basis. Brokers said the fixture is the highest VLCC rate so far this year. Sinokor has been expanding in the tanker market since late last year and was among the most active Gulf participants during the war.

【智平方郭彥東：類腦智慧將成為下一代機器人大腦的重要發展方向】6月23日至25日，世界經濟論壇第十七屆新領軍者年會（夏季達沃斯論壇）在大連舉行。智平方創始人兼CEO郭彥東在會上發表演講時提出，類腦智慧、小樣本學習以及低功耗計算，將成為下一代機器人大腦的重要發展方向。下一代機器人大腦不應只是算力和資料的競賽，更需要探索更高效、更可持續的發展路徑。當前機器人產業面臨的重要挑戰之一，是工業、公共服務以及未來家庭場景之間長期存在的應用鴻溝。解決這一問題的關鍵，在於統一硬體與統一模型。與此同時，不同場景產生的資料持續迴流至同一個機器人大腦。工業場景提升機器人精度與穩定性，公共服務場景增強互動與泛化能力，兩類能力相互促進，並最終為未來家庭應用奠定基礎。

【我國自主開發的電化學原位液相透射電子顯微裝置首次觀測到電極/電解液介面處由濃度驅動的相分離現象】據廈門大學訊息，該校孫世剛院士、廖洪鋼教授團隊聯合華中科技大學黃雲輝教授團隊等，藉助自主開發的電化學原位液相透射電子顯微裝置，首次觀測到電極/電解液介面處由濃度驅動的相分離現象，並揭示了鋰硫電池中高濃度多硫化鋰介面層的形成與演化規律。相關成果最近發表在《自然》雜誌上。鋰硫電池是下一代高比能儲能電池的重要體系，但在接近實際應用的高硫載量、貧電解液條件下，其內部反應微觀機制難以被觀測和闡釋，從而長期限制著電池能量密度、快充效能與迴圈穩定性的提升。該研究突破傳統觀測手段侷限，藉助電化學原位液相透射電子顯微鏡，實現了對鋰硫電池奈米尺度介面反應的高解析度實時動態成像。

【青海省海西州直轄區發生5.2級地震，水利部迅即啟動水利抗震救災排程指揮機制】6月23日23時29分，青海省海西州直轄區發生5.2級地震，震源深度8千米。水利部迅即啟動水利抗震救災排程指揮機制，組織專題會商，分析地震對水利工程以及防洪、供水等的影響，研判震區雨水情形勢，安排部署水利抗震救災工作。經初步排查和監測分析，震區江河水情平穩，水庫等水利工程執行正常。預報震區今日（6月24日）有小到中雨、明後2天無降雨。水利部將持續密切關注震區雨情、水情及水利工程執行情況，指導地方水利部門繼續做好震區水利工程震損排查和處置工作，嚴防發生次生災害。

Iron Ore Gains as Hot Metal Production Picks Up — Iron ore futures rose above CNY 740 per ton, rebounding modestly from near one-year lows as hot metal production showed a slight recovery, with output restarts at some steel mills helping offset blast furnace maintenance at others. Bargain hunting and short covering also lent support to prices as near-term demand in top consumer China remained relatively resilient. Lower prices encouraged buying activity among steelmakers and traders, with daily transaction volumes for seaborne cargoes increasing sharply in recent sessions. However, the market continued to face headwinds from expectations of higher exports by major suppliers and a subdued demand outlook. Mining firms are expected to boost shipments this month to meet production targets, coinciding with a seasonal slowdown in steel consumption.

Brunei Inflation Holds at 0.1% — Brunei’s consumer prices inched up 0.1% year-on-year in May 2026, matching April’s pace and marking the second consecutive month of inflation. Prices continued to rise for food and non-alcoholic beverages (1.2% vs 0.8% in April), furnishings and household maintenance (0.2% vs 0.8%), health (0.4% vs 0.4%), transport (0.4% vs 0.1%), and restaurants and hotels (0.4% vs 0.5%). Also, prices of housing and utilities increased 0.2%, swinging from a 0.4% in April. Meanwhile, education inflation held steady at 0.3%. Several categories continued to record declines, including communication (-3.4% vs -3.4%), recreation and culture (-1.0% vs -1.2%), and miscellaneous goods and services (-0.6% vs -0.5%). Prices of clothing and footwear fell 1.5%, reversing April's 3.2% increase. On a monthly basis, the CPI edged down 0.1%, following a 0.5% rise in April.

【龔正分別會見美國宣偉公司董事會主席、執行長海蒂·佩茲和比利時世索科集團執行長羅德邁】上海市市長龔正6月23日分別會見了美國宣偉公司董事會主席、執行長海蒂·佩茲和比利時世索科集團執行長羅德邁。龔正說，當前上海正以“五個中心”建設為主攻方向、重要使命，加快建成具有世界影響力的社會主義現代化國際大都市。我們正深入推進新型工業化、培育發展新質生產力，加快構建現代化產業體系，著力推動高質量發展。期待與宣偉公司、世索科集團繼續深化合作，共贏未來。希望宣偉公司進一步提升在滬總部能級，深度融入上海本土製造供應鏈，助力上海產業智慧化、綠色化、融合化發展。希望世索科集團持續加大在滬投資佈局，參與上海國際科技創新中心建設，推動更多技術成果在上海率先落地，積極助力上海綠色低碳轉型、實現“雙碳”目標。歡迎兩家企業積極參加第九屆進博會，把更多新產品、新技術、新服務帶到上海、引入中國。上海將一如既往地打造市場化、法治化、國際化一流營商環境，更好助力各類企業在滬發展。（上海商務）

Norway Jobless Rate Falls to 5-Month Low — Norway’s seasonally adjusted unemployment rate eased at 4.4% in May 2026, from 4.6% in the previous month and at its lowest level since December 2025. The number of unemployed persons eased to 135 thousand from 140 thousand in April. At the same time, the employment rate eased to 69.5% from 70.3%, as the number of employed individuals fell by 29 thousand to 2.911 million. The labor force participation rate likewise declined to 72.7% from 73.6% in April. Meanwhile, the youth unemployment rate, which covers those aged 15 to 24, rose to 14.6%, from 11.1% in the previous month.

【黃金結構性存款退潮】隨著近期金價震盪下行，多家銀行黃金結構性存款預期收益率出現縮水。背後原因是什麼？還能否進行配置？近期金價的震盪下行是本次降低預期收益率的直接原因，黃金價格走勢波動大且方向不明朗，銀行為控制自身風險，主動壓低掛鉤產品的預期收益率。經營壓力是調整的另一重要原因，維持結構性存款的較高利率將推高銀行負債成本。投資者如何進行配置 黃金結構性存款更適合作為低風險資產配置的一部分。在當前金價預期出現分化的背景下，投資者應充分了解資金佔用成本、收益觸發條件及收益區間設計。同時，需認識到產品的高檔收益率並非一定會兌現，降低對高收益的預期。（經濟日報）

Danish Retail Sales Pick Up in May — Retail sales in Denmark rose 3.8% year-on-year in May 2026, picking up from a ten-month low and an upwardly revised 1.4% increase in the previous month. Sales rebounded for supermarkets, department stores, and specialized grocery stores (3.2% vs -2.2% in April), while it increased at a faster pace for household equipment, furniture, and building materials (5.1% vs 2.4%) and cultural and leisure products (18.1% vs 17.4%). Meanwhile, trade continued to decline for liquid fuels and filling stations (-17.8% vs -14.7%). In addition, sales growth eased for consumer electronics (5.7% vs 15.1%), clothing, footwear, and jewelry (6.4% vs 10.6%), pharmacies and personal care products (3.3% vs 4.2%), and second-hand goods (13.2% vs 14.2%). On a monthly basis, retail sales rose 1.0%, rebounding from a 1.8% fall in April.

【IAEA to inspect Iran's enrichment facilities; timing unclear】IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi said inspectors will ultimately inspect Iran's enrichment facilities, though the timing is uncertain and could range from days to about ten days. He said a memorandum of understanding signed by the US and Iranian presidents stipulates that the covered nuclear activities will be under IAEA supervision and requires Iran to dilute its stock of highly enriched uranium. US vice president JD Vance said Iran agreed to invite IAEA inspectors back, but Iranian foreign ministry spokesman Baghaei said Iran has not met with Grossi and there is no concrete inspection timetable.

【機構：日本加速佈局全固態電池產業鏈，下一代電池技術全球競爭加劇】根據TrendForce集邦諮詢最新《全球固態電池產業發展動態季報_2Q26》，日本近年擴大支援下一代蓄電池技術，其經濟產業省（METI）2023年起實施《電池供應保障計劃》，重點扶持全固態電池（ASSB）、雙極型低成本磷酸鐵鋰（LFP）電池等研發與早期量產。截至2026年第一季，該計劃已核准與全固態電池供應鏈相關的五大專案，合計補助金額達6.6億美元（約1,057億日元）。

【廣電總局：微短劇按照投資額度、題材等分類實行備案公示和發行許可制度】國家廣播電視總局就《微短劇發展管理辦法（徵求意見稿）》公開徵求意見。其中提到，微短劇按照投資額度、題材等分為一類微短劇、二類微短劇和三類微短劇，分類實行備案公示和發行許可制度。一類微短劇是指投資額度較大或者主要劇情涉及政治、軍事、外交、國家安全、統戰、民族、宗教、司法、公安等內容的特殊題材的微短劇。二類微短劇是指投資額度相對不大且為一般題材的微短劇。三類微短劇是指投資額度較低且為一般題材的微短劇。分類標準由國務院廣播電視主管部門制定，並結合行業發展實際情況適時調整。

【鋰凰科技完成A+輪數千萬元戰略投資】近日，鋰凰科技宣佈，元禾厚望創新成長基金正式完成對其A+輪數千萬元戰略投資。據鋰凰科技介紹，這是繼納爾股份（002825）A輪億元級戰略投資後，公司在短期內完成的又一輪融資。本輪資金將集中投入產線升級、研發深化與產能擴充，支撐公司千噸級量產交付提速。

【廣電總局：與微短劇有關的智慧財產權受法律保護】國家廣播電視總局釋出關於《微短劇發展管理辦法（徵求意見稿）》公開徵求意見的通知。其中指出，與微短劇有關的智慧財產權受法律保護，任何組織和個人不得侵犯。從事微短劇活動的組織和個人應當增強智慧財產權意識，提高智慧財產權創造、運用、保護、管理和服務的能力。鼓勵行業創新版權服務模式。會同有關部門健全微短劇有關版權保護體系。

【廣電總局：鼓勵、支援優秀微短劇創作播出】國家廣播電視總局釋出關於《微短劇發展管理辦法（徵求意見稿）》公開徵求意見的通知。其中指出，鼓勵微短劇藝術表達、傳播方式、新技術應用、商業模式等創新。鼓勵、支援廣大群眾參與微短劇創作，激發微短劇作為網際網路條件下新大眾文藝的創新創造活力。鼓勵、支援優秀微短劇創作播出。縣級以上人民政府廣播電視主管部門根據微短劇創作的需要，為微短劇創作人員深入基層、深入群眾、體驗生活提供必要的便利和幫助。省、自治區、直轄市以上人民政府廣播電視主管部門為納入重點扶持的微短劇的上線播出提供必要支援。
【廣電總局：支援優秀微短劇境內外同步播出】國家廣播電視總局釋出關於《微短劇發展管理辦法（徵求意見稿）》公開徵求意見的通知。其中指出，支援外向型微短劇創作生產和傳播，為境外主創人員參與微短劇創作提供便利，支援優秀微短劇境內外同步播出。鼓勵和支援微短劇行業開展平等互利的國際交流與合作，促進中外文明交流互鑑。

【中遠海控、寧波港成立供應鏈新公司】企查查APP顯示，近日，寧波遠海供應鏈有限公司成立，經營範圍包含：供應鏈管理服務；海上國際貨物運輸代理；航空國際貨物運輸代理；陸路國際貨物運輸代理等。企查查股權穿透顯示，該公司由中遠海控(601919)全資子公司中遠海運集裝箱運輸有限公司、寧波港(601018)共同持股。

【Fang Xinghai says China capital markets will become highly attractive to international capital】Fang Xinghai, vice chairman of the China Finance Society, told the 2026 Summer Davos forum on June 24 that U.S. limits on capital inflows have, to some extent, stimulated China’s private equity and venture capital activity. He said China’s high savings rate leaves large room for capital; ultimately securities investment, FDI and other asset flows depend on the returns Chinese firms can deliver, and as long as innovation continues he believes China’s capital markets will become highly attractive to international capital.

【方星海：相信中國資本市場對國際資本將變得極具吸引力】6月24日，中國金融學會副會長方星海在2026夏季達沃斯論壇上表示，美國限制資本流入中國，反而在某種程度上刺激了中國的私募股權投資和風險投資。中國是一個高儲蓄率國家，在這方面的潛力是非常巨大的。“歸根結底，無論是證券投資、外商直接投資（FDI）還是其他資產類別，都取決於中國企業能否為這些資本所有者創造更多的回報。”方星海表示，只要創新的步伐不停，我相信中國資本市場對國際資本將變得極具吸引力，這才是決定資本流向的最終因素。

【東方鉭業在寧夏成立關鍵金屬材料公司】企查查APP顯示，近日，寧夏中色關鍵金屬材料有限公司成立，經營範圍包含：稀有稀土金屬冶煉；化工產品生產（不含許可類化工產品）；化工產品銷售（不含許可類化工產品）等。企查查股權穿透顯示，該公司由東方鉭業(000962)全資持股。

【易觀報告披露公共充電市場份額 滴滴充電、特來電、雲快充前三】6月22日，第三方研究機構易觀分析釋出《中國公共充電消費市場新趨勢及使用者價值研究》。報告顯示，截至2026年3月，在充電量的市場份額排名中，滴滴充電佔比34.22%位居第一，特來電佔比10.06%、雲快充佔比9.54%分列二、三名。截至2026年3月，中國公共充電市場的充電槍保有量已經達到486.3萬個。其中，公共充電槍保有量TOP10的運營商，其公共充電槍合計為245萬個。

【霍爾木茲海峽運輸量回升 油輪租金直接翻倍】隨著伊朗與美國簽署關於重開霍爾木茲海峽的諒解備忘錄後，航運資料顯示，透過霍爾木茲海峽及海灣地區的船舶運量正逐步回升。而隨著石油運輸需求上升，油輪運費價格已經大幅飆升，油輪運營商本週的利潤創下歷史新高。根據船運經紀人和行業訊息人士稱，租用霍爾木茲海峽以外地區油輪的費用，已從一週前的每週10.65萬美元飆升至每日19.05萬美元，接近翻倍。同時，在海灣以外地區租用的船隻價格也大幅上漲。

【現貨第八輪提漲全面落地 主流鋼廠焦炭價格上調】昨日準一級冶金焦的均價是1927元/噸，現貨第八輪提漲全面落地，目前主流鋼廠溼熄焦炭上調50元/噸、幹熄上調55元/噸，現貨完成漲價兌現。前期山西沁源等地煤礦安全檢查影響仍存，雖部分高硫焦煤礦井逐步復產，但復產產能僅恢復至停產前40%，低硫優質主焦煤增量嚴重不足，國內礦山產能利用率僅71.2%，礦端持續去庫。進口端蒙煤通關穩定，但以中硫1/3焦煤為主，高硫主焦補充有限，結構性煤源緊缺未緩解。焦化廠內部焦煤總庫存1069.08萬噸，周環比下降2.8%，原料可用天數持續走低，制約焦化持續增產能力。 (生意社)

【自然資源部黨組第四輪巡視完成反饋】按照自然資源部黨組統一部署，近日，第四輪巡視各巡視組分別向國家自然資源督察瀋陽局、國家自然資源督察南京局、自然資源部南海局、自然資源部油氣資源戰略研究中心、自然資源部人力資源開發中心、中國自然資源報社、中國地質博物館、自然資源部天津海水淡化與綜合利用研究所、國家海洋標準計量中心、國家海洋環境預報中心、中國大地出版傳媒集團有限公司、中國地圖出版社集團有限公司等12家單位黨組織反饋巡視意見。

【NVIDIA sought 10% PCB price cut? Shenghong Technology says operations normal, client design changes routine】June 23: China compute-power PCB sector tumbled; sector leader Shenghong Technology slid over 7% intraday. Shanghai Securities Journal attributed the drop to two market rumors: NVIDIA asked PCB vendors for a 10% price cut, and Shenghong’s capacity expansion has allegedly pressured shipments of NVIDIA’s Rubin platform. On June 24 Shenghong said it cannot respond to every rumor but reiterated that operations and fundamentals are normal. The company added customer design adjustments during production are routine, it has some first-mover advantages, and investors should rely on public disclosures.

【英偉達壓PCB降價10%？勝宏科技：公司經營一切正常，客戶方案調整是正常現象】6月23日，算力鏈的PCB（印刷電路板）板塊大跌，該板塊概念龍頭勝宏科技單日重挫逾7%。據上海證券報報道，PCB整體大跌與兩個市場傳聞有關，一個市場流傳是英偉達要求PCB廠商降價10%，另外一則是勝宏科技擴產拖累英偉達Rubin平臺出貨等。6月24日，勝宏科技接線人士表示，市場傳聞很多，公司沒有辦法就每個傳聞都做出回應。但這位人士強調，公司經營一切正常，基本面沒有變化。上述勝宏科技相關人士表示，客戶對採用什麼方案都不是一成不變，在生產過程中會有一些調整或者改進，這些都是正常現象。勝宏也有一些先發優勢。投資者要甄別一下這些傳聞，以公司公開披露資訊為準。（澎湃）

【券商暫停股票類跨境TRS新增 後續業務規模或將逐步歸零】記者多方瞭解到，昨日券商起正按照監管要求，暫停股票類跨境TRS（Total Return Swap，即跨境收益互換業務）新增規模，存量頭寸可正常到期、平倉、不強制砍倉。目前除了股票類跨境TRS，期貨類、城投債類以及部分FICC、北向相關業務，暫不受影響。該業務自2024年初已處於限制淨新增狀態，目前各家券商仍在等待細則口徑，明確新增暫停的具體執行標準。券商衍生品業務人士反饋，從目前視窗指導的理解看，更接近於股票類跨境TRS不再新增開倉，存量合約到期後逐步壓降。據瞭解，當前股票類跨境TRS通道費普遍在1%-2%，是券商高創收專案之一。 (財聯社)

【綠電點亮2026夏季達沃斯 核心場館100%綠電直供】世界經濟論壇第十七屆新領軍者年會，也就是2026夏季達沃斯論壇6月23日開始在遼寧大連舉辦，為期3天。本屆論壇全程踐行綠色理念，首次將所有會議室集中在同一樓層，核心場館更是實現100%綠電直供。國網大連市中山區供電公司副經理門志勇表示，本屆達沃斯論壇綠色辦會的一大突破，是大連國際會議中心、大連棒棰島賓館，全部使用新能源綠電供應。預計6月份將使用綠電110萬千瓦時，減少碳排放約580噸。

【Airbus to conduct urgent inspections of A380s】Airbus said on June 23 it will inspect 16 A380 aircraft and will immediately begin checks on five. The move follows discovery of cracks on critical wing components on A380s operated by Emirates and Qantas. Airbus said it has identified all A380s with the same production history and will consult the European Union Aviation Safety Agency on whether repairs are required.

NZX 50 Ends 0.3% Lower, Marking Third Straight Loss — The NZX 50 fell 35 points, or 0.3%, to close at 13,401 on Wednesday, retreating for the third consecutive session, mainly weighed down by losses in communication services, utilities, and healthcare. The broader index tracked a fall on Wall Street overnight driven by a sharp sell-off in chip stocks. Traders were also cautious ahead of the release of the US final Q1 GDP data and the May PCE Price Index later this week, which could provide clues about the Federal Reserve's monetary policy decision at its upcoming meeting, after it left interest rates unchanged last week. However, easing oil prices helped limit the decline as inflation concerns eased. Among the bottom performers were Meridian Energy (-2.5%), Summerset Group (-2.3%), Hallenstein Glasson (-1.4%), F&C Investment Trust (-1.1%), while Chorus and Contact Energy each fell 0.8%, and Ebos Group dropped 0.6%.

【蒙特利爾銀行：下調今年黃金目標價至4625美元/盎司 美聯儲加息是頭號威脅】隨著美聯儲最新鷹派傾向對市場造成衝擊，黃金價格繼續在年內低位附近徘徊，而與此同時，繼高盛、德銀之後，又一家國際投行下調了黃金目標價。蒙特利爾銀行資本市場（BMO Capital Markets）在其第三季度大宗商品展望報告中表示，預計今年下半年黃金均價約為4625美元/盎司，較此前的預期下調了5%。BMO指出，隨著市場開始積極定價年底前加息的可能性，美國貨幣政策仍是金銀價格面臨的最大且最緊迫的威脅。

【機翼再現裂紋！空客將對A380客機展開緊急檢查】空中客車公司6月23日宣佈，將對16架空客A380型客機進行檢查，其中5架的檢查工作會立即展開。此前，分別由阿聯酋航空公司和澳洲航空公司運營的空客A380客機在關鍵機翼部件上出現裂紋。位於法國圖盧茲的空中客車公司總部空客公司表示，公司已確認所有“具有相同生產歷史”的A380客機，並將對其中5架飛機立即展開檢查。此外，公司還將與歐洲航空安全域性商討是否需要對相關客機進行維修。此次將接受檢查的空客A380客機中，有15架由阿聯酋航空公司運營，1架由澳洲航空公司運營。而需要立即接受檢查的5架客機則均由阿聯酋航空公司運營。檢查最快會在24日開始。

【科力裝備獲批中央引導地方科技發展資金專案】據科力裝備訊息，近日，河北省科技廳、財政廳釋出2026年中央引導地方科技發展資金專案名單，科力裝備的“智慧駕駛汽車奈米吸光塗層攝像頭支架研發及成果轉化”專案入選。公司表示，這標誌著公司在智慧駕駛汽車視覺系統部件創新工作獲得國家層面認可與支援。

【ASML and TNO to advance photonic chip mass production】ASML (ASML.O) and the Netherlands Organisation for Applied Scientific Research (TNO) have agreed to jointly develop and commercialize photonic chips. The collaboration centers on a pilot production line under construction at TNO’s High Tech Campus in Eindhoven. Finland Producer Prices Rise in May — Producer prices in Finland advanced by 7.4% year-on-year in May 2026 from 4.6% in the previous month. Costs increased in manufactured products (6.4% vs 4.7% in April), particularly in beverages (4.9% vs 0.4%), wearing apparel (4% vs 2.6%), chemical and chemical products (4.9% vs 0.9%), and rubber and plastic products (5.3% vs 1.1%), while prices rebounded in textiles (1.0% vs. -0.6%) and basic pharmaceutical products (3.4% vs. -4.2%). In addition, inflation accelerated in mining and quarrying (11.9% vs. 9.3%), electricity, gas, steam and air-conditioning supply (17.9% vs. 1.0%), and water supply, sewerage, waste management, and remediation services (10.1% vs. 6.6%). On a monthly basis, producer prices increased 1.3% in May, following a 1.2% rise in the previous month.

Finnish Jobless Rate Highest Since 1998 — Finland’s unemployment rate increased to 12.7% in May 2026 from 10.5% in the same month a year earlier, marking its highest level since May 1998. The number of unemployed climbed by 68,000 year-on-year to 376,000, comprising 203,000 men and 173,000 women. By gender, male unemployment climbed to 13.1%, 2.3 percentage points higher than a year earlier, while the female rate increased to 12.2%, up 2.0 percentage points. Among younger workers aged 15–24, the jobless rate also rose to 37.8%, an increase of 9.7 percentage points year-on-year. Meanwhile, employment decreased by 32,000 to 2.594 million, even as the labour force participation rate picked up to 71.3% from 70.4% a year earlier. Meanwhile, the employment rate for those aged 20–64 declined, falling to 76.5% from 77.0%.

【訊息稱委內瑞拉即將披露2400億美元鉅額債務】據英國《金融時報》援引不願具名、知曉該國債務重組方案的訊息人士報道，委內瑞拉即將對外公佈債務總額達2400億美元，遠高於此前市場預估；該國即將啟動史上規模最大的主權債務重組工作。該國披露的負債規模將超出市場此前1500億至2000億美元的預估區間。注：週二委內瑞拉債券大幅下跌，投資者正靜待官方債務規模評估結果出爐。
【聯合國機構：黎巴嫩南部萬餘棟住宅樓被毀 】聯合國人道主義事務協調廳23日表示，根據一項最新評估報告，黎巴嫩南部超過1.3萬棟住宅樓完全被毀或部分受損，導致迫於戰火逃離的民眾無家可回，這一地區人道主義形勢依然嚴峻。該項評估由聯合國開發計劃署與黎巴嫩國家科學研究委員會共同完成。評估顯示，當地超過11000棟住宅樓完全被毀，另有約2200棟部分受損。
【中國駐泰國使館提醒：謹慎前往泰緬邊境地區】近期有中國公民反映，因曾前往泰國達府（Tak Province）等泰緬邊境地區，在入境泰國時被移民部門列為重點核查物件，甚至被拒絕入境。中國駐泰國使館提醒中國公民充分了解有關風險，謹慎前往達府、湄索等泰緬邊境地區。

【SoftBank's Masayoshi Son calls labeling AI a bubble 'desecration'】SoftBank CEO Masayoshi Son told shareholders on Wednesday he will work until 70 to pursue AI ambitions, abandoning an earlier plan to hand over the reins at 60 after saying he had become "greedy", and seeking another 10–15 years to chase artificial superintelligence (ASI). He rejected claims that AI is a bubble as "desecration", saying current skepticism echoes early doubts about the internet and that AI's potential is only beginning to be realized.

【北約秘書長呂特將會晤特朗普 7月峰會前試圖緩和緊張氣氛】北約秘書長呂特週三將在白宮會見美國總統特朗普，試圖在7月於安卡拉舉行的關鍵北約領袖峰會前，緩和因伊朗戰爭以及美國威脅縮減歐洲駐軍所引發的緊張局面。自特朗普2024年11月當選以來，呂特的重要職責之一就是應對他對北約的敵意，並避免緊張事件演變為持久的危機，包括特朗普推動收購格陵蘭島一事。週三的會議料將延續此一模式。"我預計他正在努力與特朗普達成一致，以確保北約峰會取得成功，而不是徹底失敗，"華府智庫卡內基國際和平基金會高階研究員Stephen Wertheim表示。

【Putin accuses West of hyping Russian military threat】June 23 — At the Kremlin, President Putin accused Western states of inflating the Russian military threat, saying they openly discuss preparing to go to war with Russia and are boosting military budgets and offensive capabilities to justify large defense spending and aggressive militarization. He said Russia is prepared to respond rapidly and appropriately to any external or internal threat, and warned that while Western states have not yet launched actions from their territories against Russia, they understand such moves would trigger retaliatory strikes.

【機構：2026年GenAI智慧手機預計佔全球出貨量45%】根據Counterpoint Research最新發布的GenAI智慧手機市場預測報告，具備GenAI能力的智慧手機預計將佔2026年全球智慧手機出貨量的45%，高於2025年的36%。不過，持續的儲存供應緊張預計將導致2026年全球智慧手機出貨量同比下降13.9%，降至10.8億部，創歷史新低。與此同時，GenAI智慧手機市場份額預計將進一步提升，預計到2027年佔全球智慧手機出貨量的52%，使GenAI技術有望成為整個市場的標準功能。

【普京譴責西方炒作俄羅斯軍事威脅】當地時間6月23日，俄羅斯總統普京在克里姆林宮發表講話，譴責西方國家不斷炒作俄羅斯軍事威脅，他表示，西方國家如今公開談論準備與俄羅斯開戰，並不斷增加致力於提升進攻能力的軍事預算，以正當化其鉅額軍事開支和激進軍事化政策。普京稱，俄羅斯隨時準備對任何外部或內部威脅做出迅速且恰當的回應。在講話之後，他還表示，儘管西方國家尚未走到從本國領土向俄羅斯發起行動這一步，但他們所有人都明白這一行為將引發報復性打擊。

【超長期特別國債支援老舊電梯更新 全國累計更新老舊電梯超36萬臺】央視財經訊息，記者今天（24日）從住房城鄉建設部獲悉，自國家將住宅老舊電梯更新改造納入超長期特別國債資金支援範圍以來，各地依託政策支援，大力推進住宅老舊電梯更新改造，目前已累計更新住宅老舊電梯超36萬臺。目前，多個省市將住宅電梯更新改造納入民生實事，北京今年計劃更新1萬多臺老舊電梯，南京也在近期啟動了今年超長期特別國債支援住宅老舊電梯更新專案。

【Agility Robotics將透過一筆25億美元的SPAC交易上市】據媒體週三援引該公司高管的話報道，Agility Robotics將透過與Churchill Capital Corp XI合併的方式上市，此次交易將使這家初創企業的估值達到約25億美元。雙方預計此次交易將籌集超過6億美元的總收益，其中包括來自Churchill XI的4.2億美元現金，以及由中國臺灣富士康牽頭的、透過“私募投資公開上市公司普通股”（PIPE）方式籌集的逾2億美元。這家上市公司將以股票程式碼AGLT上市。據其官網介紹，這家總部位於俄勒岡州的公司生產名為“Digit”的商用類人機器人。Agility已為正在研發的Digit新版本獲得訂單，該版本將具備更精細的靈巧度以移動更小的物體，並採用更高的安全標準。

【Chengdu Rail–Jinjiang consortium wins Chengdu Linjiaba 195-mu land for 4.344 billion yuan】A Chengdu Rail and Jinjiang unified-development consortium bought five parcels totalling about 195 mu in Linjiaba, Jinjiang District, Chengdu, for 4.344 billion yuan; the sale was at a 0% premium. The site comprises three residential and two commercial-service plots, with total construction land of 130,259.1 sqm and planned gross floor area of 311,137.29 sqm. The project must include at least 20,000 sqm of multi-format retail and, within three years of completion, introduce at least two national first stores and at least five Southwest- or Chengdu-first stores.

【成都林家壩5宗打包地塊43.44億元底價成交 未來新房售價或達5.2萬元/平】成都林家壩TOD核心區5宗約195畝組合地塊今日成功出讓，成交總價43.44億元，競得方為成都軌道集團與錦江統建聯合體。上述5宗土地採取整體打包出讓方式，意向競買人須同時報名參與全部地塊競買。該地塊位於林家壩TOD核心區域，疊加TOD開發、商業自持、約120米地標建築建設及代建綠地等多重成本約束。中指研究院分析師表示，經初步測算，在扣除相關開發及持有成本後，專案實際可售住宅樓面價已突破26500元/平方米，接近板塊歷史“地王”水平，專案未來新房售價預計將站上5.2萬元/平方米。
【東寶生物：公司膠原蛋白產品可作為電解銅箔生產專用工藝新增劑使用】東寶生物(300239)在互動平臺表示，公司主營明膠、膠原蛋白、空心膠囊等系列產品，不直接生產電解銅箔成品。膠原蛋白產品可作為電解銅箔生產專用工藝新增劑使用，相關產品已實現市場應用，2025年相關銷量、收入同比有所增長，是公司持續拓展的新興業務，目前該業務實現的收入佔比還較小。

【Citigroup: JD.com 618 order users hit record high, keeps Buy】Citigroup said JD.com (JD.O) recorded a record number of ordering users during its 618 campaign; demand for home services, childcare and appliance installation was strong, but overall weak consumption left promotional impact moderate. Citigroup cut its Q2 revenue and non-GAAP net income forecasts by 4.3% and 6.6%, respectively, and now forecasts Q2 revenue of CNY 342.5 billion (down 4% YoY) and non-GAAP net income of CNY 7.4 billion (up 0.4% YoY). It also trimmed 2026–28 revenue forecasts by about 1.3–1.4% and earnings forecasts by 4.4–6%, citing persistent soft consumer sentiment. Citigroup maintained its Buy rating on JD.com and left the PT at $39.

Indian Rupee Slides to One-Week Low — The Indian rupee fell to around 94.8 per dollar, retreating after a brief stabilization as renewed strength in the greenback and shifting expectations for US monetary policy overshadowed lower crude oil prices. The currency came under renewed pressure after the dollar index climbed to its highest level in more than a year, driven by growing market expectations that the Federal Reserve could implement one or two additional interest-rate hikes before the end of the year. The rupee's decline was partly cushioned by a sharp drop in oil prices, with Brent crude falling below $77 per barrel and posting losses of roughly 16.5% for the month. The decline in energy prices has been supported by signs that tanker movements through the Strait of Hormuz are gradually returning to normal. Additional support came from improving capital-flow dynamics. Foreign investment into Indian debt markets has strengthened, while equity-market outflows have moderated compared with earlier months.

【美銀：新加坡CPI資料讓新加坡金管局有更多理由在7月份觀望】美銀全球研究的兩名經濟學家在一份報告中表示，週二釋出的新加坡CPI資料讓新加坡金融管理局有更多理由在7月份採取觀望態度。這些經濟學家指出，5月份核心通脹率同比為1.4%，“出人意料地下行“，而平均預期為1.6%。他們表示，新加坡官員在CPI前景方面的基調也比之前更為溫和。這些經濟學家補充說，此外，近期全球油價回落緩解了新加坡進口成本的上漲壓力，而美聯儲偏緊縮的前景增加了全球金融狀況收緊的風險，這可能會拖累新加坡的經濟活動。

【財通福鑫定開混合：將於6月24日下午開盤起至當日收盤停牌】財通基金管理有限公司公告，截至2026年6月24日上海證券交易所午間收盤，公司旗下財通多策略福鑫定期開放靈活配置混合型發起式證券投資基金（場內簡稱：財通福鑫定開混合，交易程式碼：501046）二級市場交易價格嚴重高於基金份額淨值，出現極大幅度溢價。特此提示投資者關注二級市場交易價格溢價風險，投資者如果盲目投資，可能遭受重大損失。為維護投資者利益，本基金將於2026年6月24日下午開盤起至當日收盤停牌。

【CITIGROUP: Li Auto L8 and BYD Denza N8L launches elicit neutral market reaction】CITIGROUP research note: Li Auto (02015.HK) launched the updated L8 overnight; the model adds capabilities but discontinues a six‑seat option. Citigroup estimates debut‑month orders around 8,500, settling to monthly sales of 5,000–6,000 driven by trade‑up demand. BYD (01211.HK) unveiled the revised Denza N8L overnight; price is up RMB20,000 versus the previous model, reflecting a larger battery (72.26 kWh) and a 430 km pure‑electric range, with features otherwise similar; projected monthly sales ~3,000–4,000. The bank judges market reaction neutral and says investors will remain focused on June EV retail sales.

【Qualcomm said to be in talks to provide custom chip designs to ByteDance】People familiar with the matter say Qualcomm (QCOM.O) is negotiating with ByteDance to provide custom chip design services; if successful, ByteDance would be an early customer for Qualcomm’s design business. Sources caution talks are ongoing and outcomes are uncertain; no chip design or manufacturing agreement has been confirmed and ByteDance may pursue other partners. Discussions reportedly cover a video processing unit (VPU) design, with a target to begin mass production by year‑end.

【連續三年股息率超3%+ROE超15%，36只優質股上榜】長期高股息率且盈利能力較強的公司值得考察。據資料寶統計，5家機構評級個股中，有36股2023年至2025年股息率（按照最新收盤價計算）均超3%且扣非淨資產收益率（ROE）均超15%。具體來看，國光股份以約10.88%的股息率和15.73%的ROE位居前列；周大生和格力電器的股息率分別約為7.69%和8.05%，ROE均保持在16%以上的高位水平。這表明此類公司不僅當期回報豐厚，且資產運營效率較高。從行業屬性看，符合條件的公司多集中在家用電器、食品飲料（白酒）、商貿零售及精細化工等成熟行業。例如，瀘州老窖、山西汾酒等白酒企業，以及海爾智家、美的集團等家電龍頭均在列。這些行業通常現金流充沛，資本開支相對穩定，具備長期維持高分紅的基礎。儘管基本面指標優異，但個股近期市場表現差異顯著。36只個股年內平均下跌超14%，表現遠遜於各主要指數，僅行動教育、華潤江中、陝西煤業等個股實現了股價正收益。（證券時報）
【Pragmatic半導體推出Pragmatic NFC Protect】6月24日，Pragmatic半導體釋出Pragmatic NFC Protect PR1311，一款整合即時篡改檢測、產品真偽驗證等功能的新型柔性低碳NFC晶片。該晶片柔性且觸感無痕，可無縫整合至產品及包裝中，消費者用手機輕觸即可確認產品開封狀態與真偽。該方案早期獲取計劃已開放，面向零售、醫藥與工業等市場。（介面）

【Shanghai unveils measures to fast‑track high‑level projects by foreign biopharma firms】Shanghai municipal science and technology commission, development and reform commission and other departments issued measures to speed commercialization and customs clearance of imported drugs for foreign biopharma companies. Overseas‑market drugs that obtain Chinese approval may place pre‑approval production batches on sale if they meet drug release requirements; authorities will provide enhanced business guidance and services. The plan integrates import sampling and testing and enables 24‑hour clearance facilitation to speed circulation of clinically urgent imports. Batch‑release testing for biologics and customs inspection for imported drugs will be accelerated: sampling must occur within 3 working days of arrival, and per‑batch sample volume is cut from 3x to 2x of the full‑item inspection amount.

【美國銀行：動力煤預計將受厄爾尼諾現象支撐】美國銀行表示，儘管中東緊張局勢有所緩解，但動力煤價格可能仍會受到支撐，理由是預計將出現強烈的厄爾尼諾現象，這將帶來新的有利因素。本月早些時候，澳大利亞紐卡斯爾煤炭價格攀升至每噸150美元上方，創下約兩年來的新高。美銀表示：“儘管在海灣地區緊張局勢緩解的情況下，近期市場有所走軟，“但厄爾尼諾天氣模式“通常與南亞和東南亞部分地區更炎熱、更乾燥的天氣條件有關，應該會支撐增量煤炭消耗。”

【Reserve Bank of India: Too early to discuss rate hikes】Reserve Bank of India Governor Sanjay Malhotra said it is too early to discuss rate hikes given current geopolitical uncertainty and that future decisions will depend on incoming data. He noted that had the bank been confident of hikes in the coming months it would already have shifted policy from neutral to tightening, but it has not because uncertainty remains high. His comments come as US‑Iran peace talks have driven oil sharply lower, a tailwind for India, which imports about 90% of its oil. Malhotra added the ceasefire is fragile and full oil supply restoration will take time; upside risks to oil have eased but the RBI will closely monitor oil’s trajectory.

【軟銀孫正義寄望“超級AI”，瞄準6.189萬億美元淨資產價值】軟銀創始人孫正義希望在未來十年將這家科技巨頭的資產淨值提升至6.189萬億美元，基於人工“超級智慧”的前景設定了這一大膽目標。孫正義週三在東京舉行的年度股東大會上發表講話時承認，這個1,000萬億日元的目標雄心勃勃，但他表示，軟銀已一再證明了自身創造價值的能力。這位資深投資者將軟銀形容為一隻“下AI金蛋的鵝”。他表示，自從採用了一項圍繞超越人類能力的理論AI形式，也就是AI超級智慧構建的戰略以來，該公司的價值已成倍增長。軟銀的戰略核心在於孫正義所描述的一場全球性轉變，即從演算法驅動的進步轉向執行這些演算法所需的實體基礎設施。他說，世界正在向“實體ASI”邁進。在這一階段，瓶頸不再是模型設計，而是大規模執行先進系統所需的晶片、電力和資料中心算力。孫正義補充說，這正契合了軟銀致力於成為全球領先AI機器人公司的決心。

【美洛杉磯倉儲設施火災持續 嚴重影響空氣質量】美國洛杉磯一處大型商業倉儲設施自17日起發生火災。據美國方面訊息，截止到當地時間23日上午，火災仍未撲滅，救火工作仍在進行中。此前一度有美國媒體報道稱，該倉儲設施火災已受控。洛杉磯消防局方面表示，由於倉庫建築結構及冷庫貨架系統限制，消防人員無法對隔熱屋頂進行排煙通風，只能從外部滅火。該倉庫內儲存了大量冷凍食品。目前火勢沒有蔓延至其他建築，但由於大火釋放的濃煙不斷蔓延，導致東洛杉磯等地居民區的空氣質量受到嚴重影響。

South Korean Won at Over 2-Week Low — The South Korean won traded around 1,539 per dollar, extending losses to its lowest level in over two weeks after MSCI kept South Korea in its emerging-market category. MSCI cited persistent foreign-exchange market accessibility issues, including limited offshore won convertibility and insufficient liquidity during extended trading hours, delaying South Korea's progress toward developed-market status. Additionally, the US dollar remained relatively firm as investors continued to assess the outlook for US monetary policy. Meanwhile, the Bank of Korea reinforced its hawkish stance, signaling that higher interest rates may be needed at an appropriate time as rising housing prices, household debt, and leveraged investments threaten to fuel financial imbalances. Limiting further losses, oil prices eased as concerns over potential disruptions to energy supplies through the Strait of Hormuz softened, providing some relief for the energy-importing economy.

Sensex Starts Session Higher — India’s BSE Sensex rose about 0.3% to 76,456 at the open on Wednesday, recouping earlier losses as investors weighed the benefits of lower crude oil prices against growing expectations of further US interest-rate hikes. Market sentiment remained cautious after the benchmark fell roughly 1.2% in the previous session, pressured by weakness in information technology and metal stocks. Concerns over domestic business activity and monsoon developments also weighed on investor confidence. Among individual stocks, Indian Railway Finance Corporation shares dropped 5.4% following reports of a planned government stake sale, while Wipro drew attention after expanding its cybersecurity partnership initiatives. JPMorgan downgraded HCL Tech, Wipro, and Tata Tech, warning that AI-driven disruption, cautious enterprise spending, and geopolitical uncertainty could keep growth across India's IT sector subdued. Notable gainers were KPR Mill (12.6%), Roto (8.5%), and JSW Infrastructure (4.4%).

【Trump says Senate resolution restricting presidential war powers 'untimely'】On the 23rd, President Trump said on social media the Senate resolution limiting presidential war powers was "untimely," adding he has "driven Iran to the brink" and that Iran is "willing to make substantive concessions." He called the vote "aid and comfort to the enemy" and said senators had made his job harder but he would "get it done." The U.S. Senate on the 23rd passed a resolution requiring Trump to end U.S. military action against Iran and to obtain congressional authorization before undertaking future military action; the measure had previously cleared the House.

【Westpac: Middle East supply shock broadening second‑round inflation; still expects RBA hike in August】After Wednesday's CPI release, Westpac kept its forecast that the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) will raise rates in August. Westpac said May headline CPI undershot expectations mainly due to falls in travel, clothing and recreation prices that are largely seasonal, and this does not change its view that underlying inflationary pressure is intensifying. The bank said May data more strongly signals a widening second‑round effect from Middle East supply shocks: rising costs for fuel, transport, plastics and chemical inputs are transmitting beyond energy‑related goods. Westpac warned wage‑cost pressure in H2 2026 could further lift inflation, especially in market‑based services. Policy supports, including fuel excise relief, are expected to be withdrawn gradually over coming months, keeping inflation risks alive beyond the August monetary policy meeting.

【Qatar says US-Iran hotline vital to reopening Strait of Hormuz】Qatari PM Sheikh Mohammed said a US-Iran hotline set up during talks in Switzerland is essential to prevent “spoilers” from blocking a reopening of the Strait of Hormuz by countering misinformation and coordinating communications during sea-mine clearance. Copper Holds Decline as Dollar Strengthens — Copper futures traded around $6.1 per pound on Wednesday after tumbling more than 3% in the previous session, pressured by a stronger dollar amid hawkish expectations for Federal Reserve policy. At its latest policy meeting, Fed officials left interest rates unchanged but signaled increasing support for future rate hikes, while new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reaffirmed his commitment to restoring price stability. A stronger dollar makes dollar-denominated commodities such as copper more expensive for holders of other currencies, while the prospect of higher borrowing costs clouds the outlook for global growth and industrial metals demand. Meanwhile, analysts noted that weakness in China’s traditional copper-consuming sectors has only been partly offset by resilient demand from renewable energy, energy storage, and electronics industries.

Offshore Yuan Hits 1-Month Low — The offshore yuan depreciated to around 6.80 per dollar on Wednesday, hitting its lowest level in a month, as a stronger US dollar continued to weigh on the currency. The greenback remained supported by mounting expectations that the Federal Reserve could raise interest rates in September, with markets now assigning roughly a 70% chance of a rate hike. Further pressure came from the People's Bank of China, which continued to set the yuan's daily reference rate at weaker-than-expected levels. The central bank fixed the currency at 6.8195 per dollar on Wednesday, extending its longest streak of weaker fixings since April 2025. Meanwhile, China has effectively halted certain tungsten exports to Japan, while rare-earth magnet shipments fell to a one-year low in May, when Beijing first rolled out its global export-control regime. Such restrictions have remained in place amid tensions over Taiwan-related remarks by Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi.

Rupiah Weakness Persists as Inflation Risks Loom — The Indonesian rupiah dipped to around IDR 17,950 per U.S. dollar on Wednesday, marking its fourth straight session of losses as the dollar index hovered near a 14-month high on expectations of further Fed tightening. Risk aversion also deepened after a sharp sell-off in tech stocks, boosting demand for haven assets. Locally, caution grew ahead of June’s inflation release next week, with concerns that food costs could keep price pressures elevated. Annual inflation quickened to 3.08% in May from 2.42% in April, driven by higher staples and logistics expenses. At the same time, Indonesia’s trade surplus shrank to its smallest since 2020 in April, reducing support from export inflows. Sentiment was further hit by reports that major Japanese automakers may shift production to Vietnam, raising concerns over investment, jobs, and factory outlook. Still, hopes of continued policy tightening by Bank Indonesia, which has raised rates by 100bps since May, helped temper the rupiah’s decline.

【SFC: IPO fundraising surged 272% YoY through March】SFC 2025-26 annual report says Hong Kong capital markets recorded broad-based growth across investment funds, digital assets and equities. 【特朗普指責國會限武決議毫無意義】當地時間6月23日，美國國會參議院透過一項限制總統戰爭權力的決議，要求總統特朗普結束對伊朗軍事行動，並在今後對伊朗採取軍事行動前必須獲得國會授權。該決議此前已由眾議院透過。對此，美國總統特朗普在社交平臺發文，指責該投票"時機不當且毫無意義"，並指控贊成者向伊朗提供"慰藉"，使他的工作"更加艱難"。 據美國哥倫比亞廣播公司等媒體報道，這項決議不具有法律效力，很大程度上只是象徵性的，但在參眾兩院透過也反映出包括部分共和黨人在內的國會議員對特朗普戰爭策略的不滿。（CCTV國際時訊）

Corn Extends Decline to 9-Month Low — Corn futures fell further below $4.1 per bushel, hitting their lowest level since early September 2025, as weaker crude oil prices and favourable US crop weather weighed on prices. Ample rainfall and moderate temperatures across the US Midwest continued to pressure the market by supporting strong crop conditions. However, traders warned that excessive moisture could start to hinder crop development. Meanwhile, progress in ongoing US-Iran peace talks has improved shipping activity through the Strait of Hormuz, fueling expectations of a faster recovery in global supply and pushing crude oil prices lower. Corn prices often track crude oil due to its use as feedstock for biofuel. The US dollar also remained firm, making US commodities more expensive for foreign buyers. Strong export demand lent some support, with the USDA confirming private sales of 100,000 metric tons to Mexico, including 30,000 tons for delivery in the 2025/26 marketing year and 70,000 tons for 2026/27 delivery.

【美濫施關稅等導致拉美和加勒比海地區外資流入遇阻】聯合國拉丁美洲和加勒比經濟委員會（拉加經委會）23日在智利首都聖地亞哥釋出報告指出，由於美國越來越頻繁地採取濫施關稅等貿易措施，甚至動輒把關稅用作政治談判工具引發巨大不確定性，外資在拉美和加勒比海地區投資日趨謹慎，導致該地區去年部分產業的投資額大幅減少。最新資料顯示，受全球地緣政治緊張和美國關稅政策變化等因素影響，2025年拉美和加勒比地區吸引外國直接投資1942.33億美元，同比僅增長1.7%。（新華社）

【特朗普稱對委軍事行動“回報率”已超28倍】據俄羅斯衛星社6月24日報道，美國總統特朗普表示，美國透過出售從委內瑞拉運出的數百萬桶石油所獲得的收入，已超過2026年1月在該國開展軍事行動支出金額的28倍以上。 報道稱，今年1月初，華盛頓對加拉加斯發動襲擊，並強行控制委內瑞拉總統馬杜羅及其妻子。隨後，特朗普宣佈有意控制委內瑞拉石油並透過出售石油獲利。 特朗普在賓夕法尼亞州向支持者發表講話時表示：“我們現在從委內瑞拉賺了很多錢，為了贏得那場戰爭，我們只用了48分鐘。我們完全收回了戰爭成本，回報率達到28倍以上，甚至更多，至少是28倍。我們已經收回了所有軍事支出，因為我們從那裡運出了數百萬桶石油。” （參考訊息）

【Qwen releases Qwen-AgentWorld】Qwen today released Qwen-AgentWorld, billed as the first native Language World Model (LWM) that can simulate agent interaction environments across seven domains. Native world modeling: environment modeling is an explicit training objective beginning in continued pretraining (CPT) and maintained through CPT → supervised fine-tuning (SFT) → reinforcement learning (RL), rather than as a post‑hoc adaptation of a general LLM. Seven domains, one model: a single model covers text environments (MCP, Search, Terminal, SWE) and GUI environments (Web, OS, Android), enabling cross‑domain knowledge transfer.

【千問正式釋出 Qwen-AgentWorld】千問大模型今天正式釋出 Qwen-AgentWorld——首個原生語言世界模型（Language World Model, LWM），能夠在七大領域中模擬智慧體互動環境。原生世界建模： 環境建模從繼續預訓練（CPT）階段起即為訓練目標，貫穿 CPT → SFT → RL 全流程，而非對通用大語言模型的事後適配。七大領域，一個模型：單一模型同時覆蓋文字類環境（MCP、Search、Terminal、SWE）與 GUI 類環境（Web、OS、Android），實現跨領域知識遷移。（千問大模型）

【Micron earnings ahead: 12 banks say storage price gains will lift margins and shares】Twelve investment banks raised Micron Technology (MU.O) price targets ahead of the company’s earnings, citing AI-driven data‑centre demand, tight DRAM/NAND supply and rapidly rising ASPs. Morgan Stanley raised its PT to $1,050 from $520, kept overweight and raised Q3 forecasts, expecting DRAM and NAND ASPs to rise roughly 20% QoQ. Wedbush lifted its PT to $1,300, raised FY guidance to $22.84 EPS (from $19.16) and revenue to $38.5bn (from $33.5bn), and also sees Q3 DRAM/NAND prices up ~20% QoQ. Deutsche Bank raised its PT to $1,500, maintained buy, and said DRAM shortages could persist into 2028 or beyond; it models Q3 revenue at $35.1bn (above Micron’s guide upper $34.25bn) and sees 2027 EPS near $160 with gross margins above 80%. Citi bumped its PT to $1,200, expects elevated storage pricing into 2027—especially HBM—and projects DRAM ASPs could rise ~200% this year. Stifel raised its PT to $1,500, saying current DRAM ASPs are roughly double Micron’s initial model; data‑centre contract pricing has exceeded $2.50/GB and consumer pricing remains above $1.50/GB, implying a ~20% QoQ revenue jump. Jefferies flagged severe HBM tightness (global monthly wafer capacity ~330k today, ~480k by 2027 while near‑term demand could rise ~70%) and projects Micron Q3 storage ASPs +40–50% QoQ, Q4 +30–40%, and 2027 ASPs up ~40–45% YoY. Bernstein, Needham, Hina International, Wells Fargo, Goldman and other houses also materially raised targets (PTs now spanning roughly $900–$1,750) and reiterated that sustained supply constraints and strong AI-related demand should keep pricing and margins elevated through 2027, with some firms extending shortages into 2028.

【Multiple private funds told to suspend new cross-border TRS allocations】Multiple private fund managers said they received notices from cooperating brokerages overnight instructing them to suspend additions to managers' cross-border TRS (total return swap) exposure. TRS lets funds capture returns on overseas assets without moving principal offshore. The move follows a May CSRC-led, eight-agency implementation plan targeting illegal cross-border securities and futures fund operations and recent enforcement actions against brokers including Tiger Brokers, Futu Holdings and Longbridge Securities. After a strong run in global tech this year, many private funds had been using cross-border TRS to increase overseas tech exposure; the notice halts new TRS scale increases.

【B站公佈笑聲識別相關專利  可基於笑聲相似度觸發內容互動】天眼查智慧財產權資訊顯示，近日，B站關聯公司上海嗶哩嗶哩科技有限公司申請的 “基於笑聲識別的內容互動方法及裝置、裝置、儲存介質和程式產品” 專利公佈。摘要顯示，本公開提供了基於笑聲識別的內容互動方法及裝置、裝置、儲存介質和程式產品。該方法包括：對從電子裝置的環境中採集的音訊資料進行笑聲識別；響應於識別到所述音訊資料中存在笑聲，提取識別到的第一笑聲對應的第一笑聲特徵；將所述第一笑聲特徵與所述電子裝置的迴圈快取區中儲存的第二笑聲特徵進行匹配，以得到所述第一笑聲特徵與所述第二笑聲特徵的相似度，其中，所述第二笑聲特徵是過去經過的預設時長內提取的至少一個第二笑聲對應的笑聲特徵；基於所述第一笑聲特徵與所述第二笑聲特徵的相似度觸發與所述電子裝置當前播放內容的互動。

【多傢俬募收到通知 暫停跨境TRS新增】多位私募業人士向記者透露，昨晚陸續收到合作券商的通知，監管要求暫停管理人跨境TRS（總收益互換）規模新增。據公開資料，TRS為Total Return Swap（總收益互換)是一種金融衍生品，私募可以透過這一工具在不直接持有境外資產（本金不出境）的前提下，透過與對手券商簽訂收益互換協議，獲得該資產的收益（或虧損）。今年以來，由於全球科技板塊的亮眼表現，不少私募透過跨境TRS配置海外資產。5月以來，證監會等八部門聯合印發《綜合整治非法跨境證券期貨基金經營活動實施方案》，對老虎證券、富途控股、長橋證券等頭部跨境網際網路券商亮出重拳，內地居民違規跨境炒股空間收縮後，使用跨境TRS配置海外科技標的的私募產品愈發受到資金關注。多位私募人士透露：“相關通知較為突然，部分產品策略短期可能出現一定變化，目前正在等待進一步細化的跨境TRS額度規範。” (上證報)

【孫正義：將“建造世界上最大的資料中心”】6月24日，軟銀集團董事長孫正義在股東大會上被問及資料中心投資，孫正義透露，他正在與一位客戶就美國俄亥俄州的一個開發計劃簽署諒解備忘錄，並解釋說，如果該計劃最終敲定，“僅此一項業務就將帶來鉅額利潤”。談及資料中心的電力消耗，孫正義稱，旗下SB能源正推進美國俄亥俄州資料中心專案，“單一設施將提供相當於10座核電站的電力”，將“建造世界上最大的資料中心”。

Palm Oil Strengthens on Export Optimism — Malaysian palm oil futures hovered above MYR 4,650 per tonne, trying to recover from earlier weakness amid a softer ringgit and firmer soyoil prices on the Dalian and Chicago markets. Strong exports also supported prices, with cargo surveyors noting June 1–20 shipments rose between 19.1% and 25% from the same period in May. Supply concerns persisted as the effects of El Niño continued to point to tighter output. In Indonesia, the world's largest supplier, the B50 biodiesel mandate is set to take effect on July 1, boosting expectations for stronger domestic consumption. Meanwhile, India's palm oil imports are projected to top 600,000 tonnes in June, up from 549,356 tonnes in May, highlighting resilient demand from the world's biggest buyer. However, gains were capped by weaker crude oil prices as easing concerns over disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz weighed on the energy market. Separately, Malaysia trimmed its July crude palm oil reference price while keeping its export duty at 10%.

【中國移動董事長陳忠嶽：將構建一體化算力網 佈局超大規模智算中心】2026年MWC上海開幕式上，中國移動董事長陳忠嶽表示，未來的移動智慧將不再侷限於任何人或人和平臺，而是延伸到人類和智慧的深度協作。為此，中國移動將推進5G-A、萬兆光網、空天地一體網路部署，以AI需求牽引6G研發；打造自智網路；構建一體化算力網，佈局超大規模智算中心，打造"中心-邊緣-端側"三級協同算力體系。陳忠嶽還提出了智慧形態三階段演進：從手機"離身智慧"，到人形機器人"具身智慧"，再到人機共生的"內身智慧"，深度融入生產生活全場景。

【臺陸委會稱“臺灣人幾乎不吃鳳梨釋迦”言論令島內譁然 國臺辦回應】國務院臺辦舉行例行新聞釋出會。有記者問：就在大陸積極為臺灣部分縣市的鳳梨釋迦等農漁產品拓展銷路之際，臺陸委會發言人梁文傑近日稱，“鳳梨釋迦臺灣人幾乎不吃，可以說是完全‘仰大陸鼻息’的農產品”，引起島內輿論譁然，認為這是一味政治操弄，根本不管臺灣農民生計。請問發言人對此有何評論？發言人張晗表示，民進黨當局一貫罔顧民生、損害民利，他們不僅不關心、不在意、不解決島內基層農漁民的生計問題，還挖苦、輕視、貶損農漁業者的勞動成果，攻擊、汙衊、抹黑大陸的好意善意。公道自在人心，其胡作非為已在島內激起民怨。民進黨當局如不停止政治操弄，停止阻限兩岸交流合作，必遭民意更大反噬。

【山東省低空裝備產業鏈重點產品和典型應用場景名單公示】據“山東釋出”訊息，近日，山東省工業和資訊化廳釋出公示，擬確定低空裝備產業鏈重點產品30個、典型應用場景30個。入選的30個重點產品涵蓋低空航空器整機、低空網聯及系統裝置、核心零部件及新材料三大類別。在典型應用場景方面，國網智慧科技股份有限公司的基於無人機與系列化機器人的輸電線路壓接金具探傷與絕緣子檢零智慧檢測場景等30個場景入選，覆蓋設施巡檢、公共服務、物流快遞、農林植保、應急救援、低空安全、地理測繪、生態環境巡檢、設施維護、教育培訓等多個領域。

【SoftBank's Son: robot mass production underway; aims to buy ABB robotics by 2026】SoftBank Group chairman Masayoshi Son told shareholders on June 24 that the company has begun mass-producing robots at a factory and will formally launch them soon. He said SoftBank will aggregate top robotics firms across verticals to become an "overwhelming world leader" in robotics and plans to complete the acquisition of Swiss industrial giant ABB's robotics business in 2026.

【BANK OF KOREA says rate hike needed at appropriate time to address housing and debt risks】BANK OF KOREA reiterated a hawkish stance in its semiannual Financial Stability Report, saying accelerating Seoul-area house prices, expanding household debt and greater leverage in asset purchases could amplify financial imbalances and justify a further rate increase at an appropriate time. The report said the financial system remains broadly stable thanks to strong growth, resilient financial institutions and a healthy external payments position, but warned credit risk is rising among vulnerable households and firms despite banks’ intact capital and liquidity buffers. It noted the benchmark rate has been held at 2.5% since H2 2025 and, given inf pressure, economic conditions and financial-stability risks, the bank considers it necessary to raise the policy rate at an appropriate time.

Malaysian Ringgit Hovers Near 7-Month Low — The Malaysian ringgit traded around 4.10 per USD in late June, remaining close to its lowest level since November last year, as US rate-hike expectations continued to support the greenback and weigh on emerging-market currencies. Domestic political uncertainty also rose ahead of two state elections. The ringgit has now fallen about 4% so far this month. This prompted Bank Negara Malaysia to signal it would step up measures to stabilise the currency, including efforts to attract foreign inflows and encourage state-linked firms and corporates to repatriate overseas earnings. The central bank also noted that recent outflows primarily reflected portfolio rebalancing after earlier gains in the ringgit, rather than a deterioration in Malaysia’s underlying fundamentals. The country’s economic profile is assessed to remain strong, while the onshore foreign exchange market continues to function smoothly.

【美媒：美財長因烏克蘭協議稱商務部長是“白痴”】據報道，美國財政部長斯科特·貝森特在與商務部長霍華德·盧特尼克就烏克蘭礦產交易發生爭執時，貝森特當面稱後者是“白痴”。此次衝突源於烏克蘭稀土金屬交易的籌備工作。盧特尼克指責貝森特“破壞”了這項協議，而貝森特則稱盧特尼克提出的方案是“狗屎一樣的交易”，並當面罵他是“白痴”。2025年4月30日，美國和烏克蘭簽署了一項關於烏克蘭自然資源的協議。根據該協議，美國取得優先購買在烏克蘭所開採礦產的權利。協議規定在烏克蘭設立一個投資基金，雙方將共同承擔管理與出資責任，各自比例均為50%。

【US media: Treasury secretary reportedly called commerce secretary 'idiot' amid dispute over Ukraine minerals pact】The Hill reports Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent called Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick "an idiot" during a dispute over preparations for a rare-earth metals transaction under the US-Ukraine natural resources agreement signed April 30, 2025. 【國臺辦批民進黨當局窮兵黷武：“臺獨”是絕路 外人靠不住】6月24日，國務院臺辦舉行例行新聞釋出會。有記者問：賴清德近日稱“不會放棄提高防務支出”，並稱將另提“特別條例”或透過追加預算等方式確保防務裝備採購等順利推進。請問對此有何評論？發言人張晗表示，民進黨當局為一黨政治私利，妄圖“以武謀獨”，不斷揮霍臺灣老百姓的血汗錢窮兵黷武，企圖把臺灣民眾綁上“臺獨”戰車，只會把臺灣推入更加危險的境地。“臺獨”是絕路，外人靠不住。我們有堅定意志、堅強決心、強大能力，粉碎一切“臺獨”分裂圖謀，維護國家主權和領土完整。（央視新聞）

【軟銀孫正義放棄60多歲退休計劃，還會再幹10到15年】軟銀集團CEO孫正義週三表示，計劃繼續擔任自己創立的科技集團的最高職位十年或更久，這推翻了他長期以來宣稱將在六十多歲時交出領導權的計劃。這位68歲的科技投資者表示，他現在渴望幫助加速人工智慧的普及，並將軟銀打造成為世界領先的人工智慧機器人公司。“我還沒時間退休，”他說道，並提及軟銀正在追求他認為具有根本性的長期技術。孫正義補充說，他已經修改了自己原先的50年計劃，還會再工作10到15年。
